units.action: restrict the free movement of personal data
units.scope: within the Union
units.condition: for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data
units.proposition: Member States shall not restrict the free movement of personal data within the Union for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

units.action: prohibit the free movement of personal data
units.scope: within the Union
units.condition: for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data
units.proposition: Member States shall not prohibit the free movement of personal data within the Union for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

units.addressee: supervisory authority of the Member State concerned
units.action: act as the competent supervisory authority for the processing operations
units.scope: the Member State concerned
units.condition: processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority of the Member State concerned has the power to act as the competent supervisory authority where processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e).

units.action: apply the lead supervisory authority mechanism under Article 56
units.condition: processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e)
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are prohibited from applying the Article 56 lead supervisory authority mechanism in cases where processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e).

units.ru_label: No SA competence over courts in judicial capacity
units.action: supervise processing operations
units.scope: processing operations of courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are prohibited from supervising processing operations of courts acting in their judicial capacity.

units.action: process those personal data in compliance with the applicable data protection rules according to the purposes of the processing
units.scope: processing of personal data received in the framework of a particular inquiry
units.condition: they receive personal data in the framework of a particular inquiry in accordance with Union or Member State law
units.proposition: Public authorities that receive personal data in the framework of a particular inquiry in accordance with Union or Member State law must process those data in compliance with the applicable data protection rules according to the purposes of the processing.

units.action: provide for the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination
units.scope: designation of the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination
units.condition: the purposes and means of the processing of personal data are determined by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: Where the purposes and means of processing are determined by Union or Member State law, the Union or Member State legislator has the power to provide for the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination.

units.addressee: controller or processor with an establishment in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: the processing is in the context of the activities of an establishment of the controller or the processor in the Union, regardless of where the processing takes place
units.proposition: A controller or processor with an establishment in the Union must comply with this Regulation for any processing of personal data in the context of the activities of that establishment, regardless of where the processing takes place.

units.ru_label: Apply GDPR for non-EU offering goods or services in the Union
units.addressee: controller or processor not established in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data of data subjects who are in the Union
units.condition: the processing activities are related to the offering of goods or services to such data subjects in the Union, whether or not payment by the data subject is required
units.proposition: A controller or processor not established in the Union must comply with this Regulation for processing personal data of data subjects who are in the Union when the processing relates to offering goods or services to those data subjects, whether or not payment is required.

units.ru_label: Apply GDPR for non-EU monitoring behaviour in the Union
units.addressee: controller or processor not established in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data of data subjects who are in the Union
units.condition: the processing activities are related to monitoring the behaviour of such data subjects insofar as their behaviour takes place within the Union
units.proposition: A controller or processor not established in the Union must comply with this Regulation for processing personal data of data subjects who are in the Union when the processing relates to monitoring their behaviour insofar as that behaviour takes place within the Union.

units.ru_label: Apply GDPR under Member State public international law
units.addressee: controller not established in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: the controller is in a place where Member State law applies by virtue of public international law
units.proposition: A controller not established in the Union must comply with this Regulation for processing personal data when the controller is in a place where Member State law applies by virtue of public international law.

units.action: comply with this Regulation
units.scope: processing of personal data wholly or partly by automated means
units.exception: The Regulation does not apply if the processing is: (a) in the course of an activity falling outside the scope of Union law; (b) by the Member States when carrying out activities within the scope of Chapter 2 of Title V of the TEU; (c) by a natural person in the course of a purely personal or household activity; or (d) by competent authorities for the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and the prevention of threats to public security.
units.proposition: Controllers and processors must comply with this Regulation when they process personal data wholly or partly by automated means, except where the processing falls under the listed exclusions in points (a) to (d).

units.action: comply with this Regulation
units.scope: processing of personal data other than by automated means where the data form part of a filing system or are intended to form part of a filing system
units.exception: The Regulation does not apply if the processing is: (a) in the course of an activity falling outside the scope of Union law; (b) by the Member States when carrying out activities within the scope of Chapter 2 of Title V of the TEU; (c) by a natural person in the course of a purely personal or household activity; or (d) by competent authorities for the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and the prevention of threats to public security.
units.proposition: Controllers and processors must comply with this Regulation when they process personal data other than by automated means that form part of a filing system or are intended to form part of a filing system, except where the processing falls under the listed exclusions in points (a) to (d).

units.addressee: Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.action: comply with Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 for their processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.proposition: Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies must comply with Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 for their processing of personal data.

units.addressee: Union legislator and relevant Union institutions responsible for amending Union legal acts
units.action: adapt Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 and other Union legal acts applicable to processing by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies to the principles and rules of this Regulation
units.scope: Union legal acts governing or applicable to processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.condition: applicable to such processing by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.temporal: in accordance with Article 98
units.proposition: The Union legislator and relevant Union institutions must adapt Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 and other Union legal acts applicable to the processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies to the principles and rules of this Regulation in accordance with Article 98.

units.addressee: authorities, courts, and persons applying or interpreting this Regulation
units.action: prejudice the application of Directive 2000/31/EC, in particular the liability rules for intermediary service providers in Articles 12 to 15, by reason of this Regulation
units.scope: application and interpretation of this Regulation
units.condition: when applying or interpreting this Regulation
units.proposition: Authorities, courts, and persons applying or interpreting this Regulation must not prejudice the application of Directive 2000/31/EC, in particular the liability rules for intermediary service providers in Articles 12 to 15 of that Directive.

units.action: be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to the processing of their personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data based on consent
units.condition: Where processing is based on consent
units.proposition: Where processing is based on consent, the controller is obliged to be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to the processing of their personal data.

units.action: present the request for consent in a manner clearly distinguishable from other matters
units.scope: written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.condition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.proposition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters, the controller is obliged to present the request for consent in a manner clearly distinguishable from those other matters.

units.action: present the request for consent in an intelligible and easily accessible form
units.scope: written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.condition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.proposition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters, the controller is obliged to present the request for consent in an intelligible and easily accessible form.

units.action: use clear and plain language in the request for consent
units.scope: written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.condition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.proposition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters, the controller is obliged to use clear and plain language in the request for consent.

units.action: treat as binding any part of such a written declaration that infringes the GDPR
units.scope: parts of a written declaration used to obtain consent that also concerns other matters
units.condition: Where a part of such a declaration constitutes an infringement of the GDPR
units.consequence: Such infringing parts are not binding.
units.proposition: Where a part of such a declaration constitutes an infringement of the GDPR, the controller is prohibited from treating that part as binding.

units.action: withdraw consent
units.temporal: at any time
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to withdraw consent at any time.

units.action: inform the data subject of their right to withdraw consent
units.scope: obtaining consent
units.temporal: prior to the data subject giving consent
units.proposition: Prior to the data subject giving consent, the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of their right to withdraw consent.

units.action: make withdrawing consent as easy as giving consent
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to make withdrawing consent as easy as giving consent.

units.action: rely on the lawfulness of processing based on consent carried out before withdrawal
units.scope: processing based on consent conducted before its withdrawal
units.condition: After withdrawal of consent, with respect to processing carried out before withdrawal
units.proposition: After consent is withdrawn, the controller is permitted to treat processing based on consent that was carried out before the withdrawal as lawful.

units.action: take utmost account of whether performance of a contract, including provision of a service, is made conditional on consent to processing of personal data that is not necessary for contract performance
units.scope: assessment of whether consent is freely given
units.condition: When assessing whether consent is freely given
units.proposition: When assessing whether consent is freely given, the controller is obliged to take utmost account of whether performance of a contract, including provision of a service, is made conditional on consent to processing of personal data that is not necessary for performance of that contract.

units.ru_label: Inform other controllers of erasure request
units.action: take reasonable steps to inform controllers processing the personal data that the data subject has requested those controllers erase any links to, or copies or replications of, the personal data
units.scope: taking account of available technology and the cost of implementation; steps may include technical measures
units.condition: the controller has made the personal data public and is obliged under paragraph 1 to erase the personal data
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 and 2 do not apply to the extent that processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: Where a controller has made personal data public and is obliged under paragraph 1 to erase them, the controller must, taking account of available technology and cost, take reasonable steps (including technical measures) to inform controllers processing the data that the data subject has requested those controllers erase any links to, or copies or replications of, the personal data.

units.ru_label: Exception to para 2 duty when necessary processing
units.action: refrain from taking the steps in paragraph 2 to inform other controllers
units.condition: processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: A controller may refrain from taking the steps in paragraph 2 to inform other controllers when processing is necessary for the grounds listed in points (a) to (e) of paragraph 3.

units.ru_label: Exception to para 1 erasure duty when necessary processing
units.action: refrain from erasing personal data under paragraph 1
units.condition: processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: A controller may refrain from erasing personal data under paragraph 1 when processing is necessary for the grounds listed in points (a) to (e) of paragraph 3.

units.action: process personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.scope: personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.condition: the processing is based on Article 6(1) GDPR
units.exception: when the processing is under the control of official authority; or when the processing is authorised by Union or Member State law that provides appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects
units.proposition: A controller is prohibited from processing personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures on an Article 6(1) basis, except under the control of official authority or when authorised by Union or Member State law that provides appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

units.action: provide appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects in laws that authorise processing of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.scope: laws authorising processing under Article 10
units.condition: when enacting or maintaining Union or Member State law that authorises such processing
units.proposition: A Union or Member State legislator is obliged to provide appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects in any law that authorises processing of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures.

units.ru_label: Comprehensive conviction registers under official authority only
units.action: keep a comprehensive register of criminal convictions
units.scope: comprehensive registers of criminal convictions
units.exception: unless the register is under the control of official authority
units.proposition: A controller is prohibited from keeping any comprehensive register of criminal convictions unless it is under the control of official authority.

units.ru_label: Take measures to provide specified info/comms
units.action: take appropriate measures to provide to the data subject the information and communications specified
units.scope: any information referred to in Articles 13 and 14 and any communication under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to take appropriate measures to provide to the data subject the information in Articles 13 and 14 and the communications under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing.

units.ru_label: Ensure concise transparent intelligible accessible form
units.action: ensure that the information and communications provided are in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form
units.scope: the information and communications covered by Article 12(1)
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that the information and communications provided are in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form.

units.ru_label: Use clear and plain language (incl. child-directed info)
units.action: use clear and plain language for the information and communications provided
units.scope: the information and communications covered by Article 12(1), including information addressed specifically to a child
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to use clear and plain language for the information and communications provided, including where the information is addressed specifically to a child.

units.ru_label: Provide in writing or by other means
units.action: provide the information to the data subject in writing or by other means
units.scope: the information covered by Article 12(1)
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the information to the data subject in writing or by other means.

units.action: provide the information to the data subject by electronic means
units.scope: the information covered by Article 12(1)
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to provide the information to the data subject by electronic means where appropriate.

units.ru_label: Oral provision upon request with identity proven
units.action: provide the information to the data subject orally
units.scope: the information covered by Article 12(1)
units.condition: when requested by the data subject and the identity of the data subject is proven by other means
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to provide the information to the data subject orally when the data subject requests it and the data subject’s identity is proven by other means.

units.ru_label: Facilitate exercise of data subject rights (Arts 15-22)
units.action: facilitate the exercise of the data subject’s rights
units.scope: rights under Articles 15 to 22
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to facilitate the exercise of the data subject’s rights under Articles 15 to 22.

units.action: refuse to act on a data subject's request to exercise rights
units.scope: requests to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: a data subject makes a request to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22
units.exception: the controller demonstrates it is not in a position to identify the data subject
units.proposition: The controller shall not refuse to act on a data subject's request to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22 unless the controller demonstrates it is not in a position to identify the data subject.

units.action: provide the data subject with information on action taken on a request
units.scope: requests under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: upon receipt of the data subject's request
units.temporal: without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request
units.proposition: The controller shall provide the data subject with information on action taken on a request under Articles 15 to 22 without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request.

units.action: extend the one-month response period by two further months
units.scope: responding to requests under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests
units.temporal: extension of up to two further months
units.proposition: The controller may extend the one-month period for responding to a request under Articles 15 to 22 by two further months where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests.

units.action: inform the data subject of the extension and the reasons for the delay
units.scope: extensions of the response period under Article 12(3)
units.condition: when the response period is extended
units.temporal: within one month of receipt of the request
units.proposition: When the response period is extended, the controller shall inform the data subject of the extension together with the reasons for the delay within one month of receipt of the request.

units.action: provide the information by electronic means
units.scope: information on action taken on the request
units.condition: the data subject made the request by electronic form means and providing the information electronically is possible
units.exception: unless the data subject otherwise requests
units.proposition: Where the data subject makes the request by electronic form means and it is possible, the controller shall provide the information by electronic means unless the data subject otherwise requests.

units.action: inform the data subject of the reasons for not taking action and of the possibility of lodging a complaint with a supervisory authority and seeking a judicial remedy
units.scope: requests by the data subject, including those under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: if the controller does not take action on the data subject's request
units.temporal: without delay and at the latest within one month of receipt of the request
units.proposition: If the controller does not take action on the data subject's request, the controller shall inform the data subject without delay and at the latest within one month of receipt of the request of the reasons for not taking action and of the possibility of lodging a complaint with a supervisory authority and seeking a judicial remedy.

units.action: provide information, communications and actions free of charge
units.scope: information under Articles 13 and 14 and any communication or actions taken under Articles 15 to 22 and 34
units.proposition: Information under Articles 13 and 14 and any communication or actions taken under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 shall be provided by the controller free of charge.

units.action: charge a reasonable fee
units.scope: fee taking into account the administrative costs of providing the information or communication or taking the action requested
units.condition: the data subject's requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character
units.proposition: Where the data subject's requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character, the controller may charge a reasonable fee taking into account the administrative costs of providing the information or communication or taking the action requested.

units.action: refuse to act on the request
units.scope: requests from a data subject
units.condition: the data subject's requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character
units.proposition: Where the data subject's requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character, the controller may refuse to act on the request.

units.action: bear the burden of demonstrating that the request is manifestly unfounded or excessive
units.scope: data subject requests
units.condition: when asserting that a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive
units.proposition: The controller shall bear the burden of demonstrating the manifestly unfounded or excessive character of the request.

units.action: request additional information necessary to confirm the data subject's identity
units.scope: requests referred to in Articles 15 to 21
units.condition: the controller has reasonable doubts concerning the identity of the natural person making the request
units.exception: without prejudice to Article 11
units.proposition: Where the controller has reasonable doubts concerning the identity of the natural person making a request referred to in Articles 15 to 21, the controller may request the provision of additional information necessary to confirm the data subject's identity, without prejudice to Article 11.

units.action: provide information in combination with standardised icons
units.scope: information to be provided to data subjects pursuant to Articles 13 and 14, in order to give an easily visible, intelligible and clearly legible meaningful overview of the intended processing
units.proposition: The controller may provide information to data subjects pursuant to Articles 13 and 14 in combination with standardised icons in order to give in an easily visible, intelligible and clearly legible manner a meaningful overview of the intended processing.

units.action: ensure that icons presented electronically are machine-readable
units.scope: standardised icons presenting information
units.condition: the icons are presented electronically
units.proposition: Where the icons are presented electronically, the controller shall ensure they are machine-readable.

units.action: adopt delegated acts determining the information to be presented by the icons and the procedures for providing standardised icons
units.scope: determining the information to be presented by icons and procedures for providing standardised icons
units.condition: in accordance with Article 92
units.proposition: The European Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 92 to determine the information to be presented by the icons and the procedures for providing standardised icons.

units.action: obtain from the controller the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her
units.scope: inaccurate personal data concerning the data subject
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller, without undue delay, the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her.

units.action: have incomplete personal data completed, including by providing a supplementary statement
units.scope: incomplete personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: taking into account the purposes of the processing
units.proposition: Taking into account the purposes of the processing, the data subject has the right to have incomplete personal data completed, including by providing a supplementary statement.

units.action: obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data concerning him or her
units.scope: personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: where at least one of the following grounds applies: (a) the personal data are no longer necessary in relation to the purposes for which they were collected or otherwise processed; (b) the data subject withdraws consent on which the processing is based according to point (a) of Article 6(1), or point (a) of Article 9(2), and where there is no other legal ground for the processing; (c) the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(1) and there are no overriding legitimate grounds for the processing, or the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(2); (d) the personal data have been unlawfully processed; (e) the personal data have to be erased for compliance with a legal obligation in Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject; (f) the personal data have been collected in relation to the offer of information society services referred to
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller, without undue delay, the erasure of personal data concerning him or her where at least one of the listed grounds applies.

units.action: erase personal data concerning the data subject
units.scope: personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: where at least one of the following grounds applies: (a) the personal data are no longer necessary in relation to the purposes for which they were collected or otherwise processed; (b) the data subject withdraws consent on which the processing is based according to point (a) of Article 6(1), or point (a) of Article 9(2), and where there is no other legal ground for the processing; (c) the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(1) and there are no overriding legitimate grounds for the processing, or the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(2); (d) the personal data have been unlawfully processed; (e) the personal data have to be erased for compliance with a legal obligation in Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject; (f) the personal data have been collected in relation to the offer of information society services referred to
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to erase personal data concerning the data subject, without undue delay, where at least one of the listed grounds applies.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the accuracy of the personal data is contested by the data subject
units.temporal: for a period enabling the controller to verify the accuracy of the personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the accuracy of the personal data is contested, for a period enabling the controller to verify the accuracy.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes erasure of the personal data and requests restriction of their use instead
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes erasure of the personal data and requests restriction of their use instead.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the controller no longer needs the personal data for the purposes of processing but the data are required by the data subject for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the controller no longer needs the personal data for the purposes of processing but the data are required by the data subject for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the data subject has objected to processing pursuant to Article 21(1)
units.temporal: pending verification whether the controller's legitimate grounds override those of the data subject
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the data subject has objected to processing pursuant to Article 21(1), pending verification whether the controller's legitimate grounds override those of the data subject.

units.action: process personal data subject to restriction under Article 18(1)
units.scope: personal data for which processing has been restricted under Article 18(1)
units.condition: processing has been restricted under Article 18(1)
units.exception: storage; processing with the data subject's consent; processing for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims; processing for the protection of the rights of another natural or legal person; processing for reasons of important public interest of the Union or of a Member State
units.proposition: When processing has been restricted under Article 18(1), the controller is prohibited from processing the personal data except for storage, with the data subject's consent, for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims, for the protection of the rights of another natural or legal person, or for reasons of important public interest of the Union or of a Member State.

units.action: inform the data subject that the restriction of processing will be lifted
units.scope: data subject who has obtained restriction of processing under Article 18(1)
units.condition: the data subject has obtained restriction of processing pursuant to Article 18(1)
units.temporal: before the restriction of processing is lifted
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject who has obtained restriction of processing under Article 18(1) before the restriction of processing is lifted.

units.action: withdraw a certification
units.scope: certifications issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to withdraw a certification issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: SA power order CB to withdraw certification
units.action: order the certification body to withdraw a certification
units.scope: certifications issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the certification body to withdraw a certification issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: SA power order CB not to issue certification
units.action: order the certification body not to issue a certification
units.scope: certifications under Articles 42 and 43
units.condition: the requirements for the certification are not or are no longer met
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the certification body not to issue a certification if the requirements for the certification are not or are no longer met.

units.action: impose an administrative fine
units.scope: pursuant to Article 83, in addition to or instead of the measures referred to in paragraph 2
units.condition: depending on the circumstances of each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to impose an administrative fine pursuant to Article 83, in addition to or instead of the measures referred to in paragraph 2, depending on the circumstances of each individual case.

units.action: order the suspension of data flows
units.scope: to a recipient in a third country or to an international organisation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the suspension of data flows to a recipient in a third country or to an international organisation.

units.action: advise the controller
units.scope: in accordance with the prior consultation procedure referred to in Article 36
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to advise the controller in accordance with the prior consultation procedure referred to in Article 36.

units.ru_label: SA power issue opinions to institutions and public
units.action: issue opinions
units.scope: to the national parliament, the Member State government, other institutions and bodies in accordance with Member State law, and to the public, on any issue related to the protection of personal data; on its own initiative or on request
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to issue, on its own initiative or on request, opinions to the national parliament, the Member State government, other institutions and bodies in accordance with Member State law, and to the public on any issue related to the protection of personal data.

units.action: authorise processing referred to in Article 36(5)
units.condition: the law of the Member State requires such prior authorisation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to authorise processing referred to in Article 36(5) if the law of the Member State requires such prior authorisation.

units.ru_label: SA power issue opinion on draft codes
units.action: issue an opinion on draft codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to issue an opinion on draft codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(5).

units.action: approve draft codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to approve draft codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(5).

units.action: accredit certification bodies
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to accredit certification bodies pursuant to Article 43.

units.action: issue certifications
units.scope: in accordance with Article 42(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to issue certifications in accordance with Article 42(5).

units.action: approve criteria of certification
units.scope: in accordance with Article 42(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to approve criteria of certification in accordance with Article 42(5).

units.action: adopt standard data protection clauses
units.scope: referred to in Article 28(8) and Article 46(2)(d)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to adopt standard data protection clauses referred to in Article 28(8) and in point (d) of Article 46(2).

units.action: authorise contractual clauses
units.scope: referred to in point (a) of Article 46(3)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to authorise contractual clauses referred to in point (a) of Article 46(3).

units.action: authorise administrative arrangements
units.scope: referred to in point (b) of Article 46(3)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to authorise administrative arrangements referred to in point (b) of Article 46(3).

units.action: approve binding corporate rules
units.scope: pursuant to Article 47
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to approve binding corporate rules pursuant to Article 47.

units.ru_label: SA obligation safeguards when exercising powers
units.action: exercise its powers subject to appropriate safeguards, including effective judicial remedy and due process
units.scope: safeguards set out in Union and Member State law in accordance with the Charter; powers conferred pursuant to this Article
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall exercise its powers subject to appropriate safeguards, including effective judicial remedy and due process, as set out in Union and Member State law in accordance with the Charter.

units.ru_label: MS obligation ensure SA can notify judiciary
units.action: provide by law that its supervisory authority has the power to bring infringements to the attention of the judicial authorities
units.scope: to enforce the provisions of this Regulation
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law that its supervisory authority has the power to bring infringements of this Regulation to the attention of the judicial authorities in order to enforce the provisions of this Regulation.

units.ru_label: MS obligation ensure SA can engage in proceedings
units.action: provide by law that its supervisory authority has the power to commence or otherwise engage in legal proceedings
units.scope: to enforce the provisions of this Regulation
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law that its supervisory authority has the power, where appropriate, to commence or otherwise engage in legal proceedings in order to enforce the provisions of this Regulation.

units.ru_label: MS permission grant additional SA powers
units.action: provide by law that its supervisory authority has additional powers
units.scope: additional to those referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
units.proposition: Each Member State may provide by law that its supervisory authority has additional powers to those referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3.

units.ru_label: SA prohibition impair Chapter VII via extra powers
units.action: exercise additional powers in a way that impairs the effective operation of Chapter VII
units.scope: additional powers provided by Member State under paragraph 6
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not exercise additional powers provided under paragraph 6 in a way that impairs the effective operation of Chapter VII.

units.action: obtain from the controller confirmation whether personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.scope: confirmation of processing status of personal data concerning the data subject
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller confirmation whether personal data concerning them are being processed.

units.action: obtain access to personal data concerning the data subject
units.scope: personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain access to personal data concerning them where such personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the purposes of the processing
units.scope: purposes of the processing
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the purposes of the processing where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the categories of personal data concerned
units.scope: categories of personal data concerned
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the categories of personal data concerned where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the recipients or categories of recipient to whom the personal data have been or will be disclosed
units.scope: recipients or categories of recipient, including recipients in third countries or international organisations
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the recipients or categories of recipient to whom their personal data have been or will be disclosed, including recipients in third countries or international organisations, where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller the envisaged period for which the personal data will be stored
units.scope: envisaged storage period for the personal data
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed and it is possible to indicate the envisaged storage period
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the envisaged period for which their personal data will be stored where their personal data are being processed and it is possible to indicate that period.

units.action: obtain from the controller the criteria used to determine the storage period
units.scope: criteria used to determine the storage period
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed and it is not possible to indicate the envisaged storage period
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the criteria used to determine the storage period where their personal data are being processed and it is not possible to indicate the envisaged storage period.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the existence of the right to request rectification or erasure or restriction of processing or to object to processing
units.scope: existence of the rights to rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and to object
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the existence of the right to request rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing or to object to such processing where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
units.scope: right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller any available information as to the source of the personal data
units.scope: any available information as to the source of the personal data
units.condition: where the personal data were not collected from the data subject and the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: Where the personal data were not collected from the data subject, the data subject has the right to obtain from the controller any available information as to their source where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4)
units.scope: existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4)
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller meaningful information about the logic involved in automated decision-making, including profiling
units.scope: meaningful information about the logic involved in automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4)
units.condition: where there is automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), and the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: Where there is automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), the data subject has the right to obtain from the controller meaningful information about the logic involved.

units.action: obtain from the controller information about the significance and the envisaged consequences of automated decision-making for the data subject
units.scope: significance and envisaged consequences of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), for the data subject
units.condition: where there is automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), and the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: Where there is automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), the data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information about the significance and the envisaged consequences of such processing for them.

units.action: be informed of the appropriate safeguards pursuant to Article 46 relating to the transfer
units.scope: appropriate safeguards under Article 46 for transfers of personal data
units.condition: where personal data are transferred to a third country or to an international organisation
units.proposition: Where personal data are transferred to a third country or to an international organisation, the data subject has the right to be informed of the appropriate safeguards pursuant to Article 46 relating to the transfer.

units.action: provide the data subject with a copy of the personal data undergoing processing
units.scope: copy of the data subject's personal data undergoing processing
units.condition: upon the data subject's request under Article 15
units.proposition: Upon the data subject's request under Article 15, the controller must provide the data subject with a copy of the personal data undergoing processing.

units.action: charge a reasonable fee based on administrative costs
units.scope: further copies of the data subject's personal data requested by the data subject
units.condition: for any further copies requested by the data subject
units.proposition: For any further copies requested by the data subject, the controller may charge a reasonable fee based on administrative costs.

units.action: provide the information in a commonly used electronic form
units.scope: information provided in response to an Article 15 request, including the copy and the listed information
units.condition: where the data subject makes the request by electronic means
units.exception: unless otherwise requested by the data subject
units.proposition: Where the data subject makes the request by electronic means, the controller must provide the information in a commonly used electronic form unless the data subject requests otherwise.

units.action: provide a copy under Article 15(3) in a manner that adversely affects the rights and freedoms of others
units.scope: provision of copies of personal data to the data subject under Article 15(3)
units.condition: when providing a copy under Article 15(3)
units.proposition: The controller must not provide a copy under Article 15(3) in a way that adversely affects the rights and freedoms of others.

units.action: provide the data subject with the identity of the controller
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the identity of the controller at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the identity of the controller's representative
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and the controller has a representative
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where the controller has a representative, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the identity of the controller's representative at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller's representative
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and the controller has a representative
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where the controller has a representative, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller's representative at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the data protection officer
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and provision of the data protection officer's contact details is applicable
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where applicable, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the contact details of the data protection officer at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the purposes for which the personal data are intended to be processed
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the purposes for which the personal data are intended to be processed at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the legal basis for the processing
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the legal basis for the processing at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide legitimate interests (if Art 6(1)(f) relied on)
units.action: provide the data subject with the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or by a third party
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the processing is based on point (f) of Article 6(1)
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where processing is based on point (f) of Article 6(1), the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or by a third party at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the recipients or categories of recipients of the personal data
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and there are recipients or categories of recipients
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: If there are recipients or categories of recipients, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the recipients or categories of recipients of the personal data at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide intent to transfer to third country or IO (if applicable)
units.action: inform the data subject of the intention to transfer personal data to a third country or international organisation
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the controller intends to transfer personal data to a third country or international organisation
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where the controller intends to transfer personal data to a third country or international organisation, the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of that intention at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide existence or absence of adequacy decision (for intended transfer)
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence or absence of an adequacy decision by the Commission for the intended transfer
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the controller intends to transfer personal data to a third country or international organisation
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: For an intended transfer to a third country or international organisation, the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence or absence of an adequacy decision by the Commission at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide reference to safeguards (Art 46, 47, or 49(1) second subpara transfers)
units.action: provide the data subject with a reference to the appropriate or suitable safeguards for the transfer
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the transfer is made under Article 46 or 47 or the second subparagraph of Article 49(1)
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: In the case of transfers under Article 46 or 47 or the second subparagraph of Article 49(1), the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with a reference to the appropriate or suitable safeguards for the transfer at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide means to obtain or access safeguards (Art 46, 47, or 49(1) second subpara transfers)
units.action: inform the data subject of the means by which to obtain a copy of the safeguards or where they have been made available
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the transfer is made under Article 46 or 47 or the second subparagraph of Article 49(1)
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: In the case of transfers under Article 46 or 47 or the second subparagraph of Article 49(1), the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the means by which to obtain a copy of the safeguards or where they have been made available at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the period for which the personal data will be stored
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: except where it is not possible to determine the storage period and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the period for which the personal data will be stored at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, except where it is not possible to determine the storage period and unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide storage period criteria (if period not possible)
units.action: provide the data subject with the criteria used to determine the storage period
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and it is not possible to provide the period for which the personal data will be stored
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: If it is not possible to provide the period for which the personal data will be stored, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the criteria used to determine that period at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to request access
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request access to personal data from the controller
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request access to personal data from the controller at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to request rectification
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request rectification of personal data
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request rectification of personal data at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to request erasure
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request erasure of personal data
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request erasure of personal data at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to request restriction
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request restriction of processing concerning the data subject
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to request restriction of processing concerning the data subject at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to object to processing
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to object to processing at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to data portability
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to data portability
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to data portability at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to withdraw consent (if processing based on consent)
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of the right to withdraw consent at any time
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and the processing is based on point (a) of Article 6(1) or point (a) of Article 9(2)
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where processing is based on point (a) of Article 6(1) or point (a) of Article 9(2), the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the existence of the right to withdraw consent at any time at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about right to lodge a complaint
units.action: inform the data subject of the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform whether provision of data is statutory, contractual, or necessary to enter a contract
units.action: inform the data subject whether the provision of personal data is a statutory requirement, a contractual requirement, or a requirement necessary to enter into a contract
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject whether the provision of personal data is a statutory requirement, a contractual requirement, or a requirement necessary to enter into a contract at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform whether data subject is obliged to provide data
units.action: inform the data subject whether the data subject is obliged to provide the personal data
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject whether the data subject is obliged to provide the personal data at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about consequences of failure to provide data
units.action: inform the data subject of the possible consequences of failure to provide the personal data
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject of the possible consequences of failure to provide the personal data at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform about existence of automated decision-making (if applicable under Art 22)
units.action: inform the data subject of the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4)
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4) applies
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4) applies, the controller is obliged to inform the data subject of its existence at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide meaningful information about logic involved in ADM (if applicable)
units.action: provide the data subject with meaningful information about the logic involved in such automated decision-making
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4) applies
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: In cases of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with meaningful information about the logic involved at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide significance of ADM for the data subject (if applicable)
units.action: provide the data subject with information about the significance of such automated decision-making for the data subject
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4) applies
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: In cases of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with information about the significance of such processing for the data subject at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Provide envisaged consequences of ADM for the data subject (if applicable)
units.action: provide the data subject with information about the envisaged consequences of such automated decision-making for the data subject
units.condition: where personal data are collected from the data subject and automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4) applies
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: In cases of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4), the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with information about the envisaged consequences of such processing for the data subject at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform prior to further processing about new purpose
units.action: provide the data subject with information on the other purpose of the intended further processing
units.condition: where the controller intends to further process the personal data for a purpose other than that for which the personal data were collected
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: prior to the further processing
units.proposition: Where the controller intends to further process the personal data for a purpose other than that for which they were collected, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with information on that other purpose prior to the further processing, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.ru_label: Inform prior to further processing about relevant Art 13(2) information
units.action: provide the data subject with any relevant further information as referred to in Article 13(2)
units.condition: where the controller intends to further process the personal data for a purpose other than that for which the personal data were collected
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: prior to the further processing
units.proposition: Where the controller intends to further process the personal data for a purpose other than that for which they were collected, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with any relevant further information as referred to in Article 13(2) prior to the further processing, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing
