units.proposition: When recording transfers to a third country or an international organisation, the processor shall include the identification of that third country or international organisation.

units.action: include the identification of the third country or international organisation to which personal data are transferred
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(2)
units.condition: when transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation are recorded and a representative is designated
units.proposition: When recording transfers to a third country or an international organisation, the processor's representative shall include the identification of that third country or international organisation.

units.action: include documentation of suitable safeguards for transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1)
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(2)
units.condition: in the case of transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1)
units.proposition: In the case of transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1), the processor shall include documentation of suitable safeguards.

units.action: include documentation of suitable safeguards for transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1)
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(2)
units.condition: in the case of transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1) and a representative is designated
units.proposition: In the case of transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1), the processor's representative shall include documentation of suitable safeguards.

units.action: include a general description of the technical and organisational security measures referred to in Article 32(1)
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(2)
units.condition: where possible
units.proposition: Where possible, the processor shall include in the record a general description of the technical and organisational security measures referred to in Article 32(1).

units.action: include a general description of the technical and organisational security measures referred to in Article 32(1)
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(2)
units.condition: where possible and a representative is designated
units.proposition: Where possible, the processor's representative shall include in the record a general description of the technical and organisational security measures referred to in Article 32(1).

units.action: ensure the record is in writing
units.scope: records referred to in Article 30(1) and (2), including in electronic form
units.proposition: The controller shall ensure the record is in writing, including in electronic form.

units.action: ensure the record is in writing
units.scope: records referred to in Article 30(1) and (2), including in electronic form
units.condition: where applicable (a representative is designated)
units.proposition: Where applicable, the controller's representative shall ensure the record is in writing, including in electronic form.

units.action: ensure the record is in writing
units.scope: records referred to in Article 30(1) and (2), including in electronic form
units.proposition: The processor shall ensure the record is in writing, including in electronic form.

units.action: ensure the record is in writing
units.scope: records referred to in Article 30(1) and (2), including in electronic form
units.condition: where applicable (a representative is designated)
units.proposition: Where applicable, the processor's representative shall ensure the record is in writing, including in electronic form.

units.action: make the record available to the supervisory authority
units.scope: the record referred to in Article 30
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority
units.proposition: On request, the controller shall make the record available to the supervisory authority.

units.action: make the record available to the supervisory authority
units.scope: the record referred to in Article 30
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority and where applicable (a representative is designated)
units.proposition: On request and where applicable, the controller's representative shall make the record available to the supervisory authority.

units.action: make the record available to the supervisory authority
units.scope: the record referred to in Article 30
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority
units.proposition: On request, the processor shall make the record available to the supervisory authority.

units.action: make the record available to the supervisory authority
units.scope: the record referred to in Article 30
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority and where applicable (a representative is designated)
units.proposition: On request and where applicable, the processor's representative shall make the record available to the supervisory authority.

units.action: notify the competent supervisory authority of the personal data breach
units.scope: to the supervisory authority competent in accordance with Article 55
units.condition: in the case of a personal data breach
units.exception: unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.temporal: without undue delay after becoming aware of the personal data breach
units.proposition: The controller shall, in the case of a personal data breach, notify the competent supervisory authority without undue delay after becoming aware of the breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.

units.action: notify the competent supervisory authority of the personal data breach
units.scope: to the supervisory authority competent in accordance with Article 55
units.condition: in the case of a personal data breach and where feasible
units.exception: unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.temporal: not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of the personal data breach
units.proposition: Where feasible, the controller shall notify the competent supervisory authority not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of a personal data breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.

units.action: accompany the notification to the supervisory authority with reasons for the delay
units.scope: notification under Article 33(1)
units.condition: where the notification to the supervisory authority is not made within 72 hours
units.temporal: at the time of the late notification
units.proposition: Where the notification to the supervisory authority is not made within 72 hours, the controller shall accompany the notification with reasons for the delay.

units.action: notify the controller of a personal data breach
units.scope: to the controller
units.condition: after becoming aware of a personal data breach
units.temporal: without undue delay after becoming aware
units.proposition: The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach.

units.action: include in the notification a description of the nature of the personal data breach
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall include in the notification a description of the nature of the personal data breach.

units.action: include the categories and approximate number of data subjects concerned
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1) and where possible
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall, where possible, include the categories and approximate number of data subjects concerned.

units.action: include the categories and approximate number of personal data records concerned
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1) and where possible
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall, where possible, include the categories and approximate number of personal data records concerned.

units.action: communicate the name and contact details of the data protection officer or other contact point for more information
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall communicate the name and contact details of the data protection officer or other contact point for more information.

units.action: describe the likely consequences of the personal data breach
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall describe the likely consequences of the personal data breach.

units.action: describe the measures taken or proposed to be taken to address the personal data breach
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall describe the measures taken or proposed to be taken to address the personal data breach.

units.action: include measures to mitigate the possible adverse effects of the personal data breach
units.scope: content of the notification to the supervisory authority under Article 33(1)
units.condition: when notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1) and where appropriate
units.proposition: When notifying the supervisory authority under Article 33(1), the controller shall, where appropriate, include measures to mitigate the possible adverse effects of the personal data breach.

units.action: provide the required information in phases
units.scope: information required by Article 33(3) for the notification to the supervisory authority
units.condition: where, and in so far as, it is not possible to provide the information at the same time
units.temporal: without undue further delay
units.proposition: Where, and in so far as, it is not possible to provide the information at the same time, the controller may provide the required information in phases without undue further delay.

units.action: document any personal data breaches
units.scope: documentation of personal data breaches
units.proposition: The controller shall document any personal data breaches.

units.action: include in the documentation the facts relating to the personal data breach
units.scope: documentation of personal data breaches
units.condition: when documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5)
units.proposition: When documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5), the controller shall include in the documentation the facts relating to the personal data breach.

units.action: include in the documentation the effects of the personal data breach
units.scope: documentation of personal data breaches
units.condition: when documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5)
units.proposition: When documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5), the controller shall include in the documentation the effects of the personal data breach.

units.action: include in the documentation the remedial action taken
units.scope: documentation of personal data breaches
units.condition: when documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5)
units.proposition: When documenting personal data breaches under Article 33(5), the controller shall include in the documentation the remedial action taken.

units.action: ensure the documentation enables the supervisory authority to verify compliance with Article 33
units.scope: documentation of personal data breaches
units.proposition: The controller shall ensure the documentation enables the supervisory authority to verify compliance with Article 33.

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: taking into account the state of the art, implementation costs, and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, as well as risks of varying likelihood and severity to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.proposition: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account specified factors, to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: taking into account the state of the art, implementation costs, and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, as well as risks of varying likelihood and severity to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.proposition: The processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account specified factors, to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

units.action: include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures
units.scope: personal data processed
units.condition: as appropriate to the risk
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures.

units.action: include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures
units.scope: personal data processed
units.condition: as appropriate to the risk
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures.

units.action: include encryption in the implemented security measures
units.scope: personal data processed
units.condition: as appropriate to the risk
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, include encryption in the implemented security measures.

units.action: include encryption in the implemented security measures
units.scope: personal data processed
units.condition: as appropriate to the risk
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, include encryption in the implemented security measures.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure confidentiality
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure confidentiality
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure integrity
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing integrity of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure integrity
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing integrity of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure availability
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing availability of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure availability
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing availability of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure resilience
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing resilience of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to ensure resilience
units.scope: processing systems and services
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: ongoing
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement measures that provide the ability to ensure the ongoing resilience of processing systems and services.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to restore availability
units.scope: personal data
units.condition: in the event of a physical or technical incident
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The controller shall implement measures that provide the ability to restore the availability of personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to restore availability
units.scope: personal data
units.condition: in the event of a physical or technical incident
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The processor shall implement measures that provide the ability to restore the availability of personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to restore access
units.scope: personal data
units.condition: in the event of a physical or technical incident
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The controller shall implement measures that provide the ability to restore access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident.

units.action: implement measures that provide the ability to restore access
units.scope: personal data
units.condition: in the event of a physical or technical incident
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The processor shall implement measures that provide the ability to restore access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident.

units.action: implement a process for testing the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly testing the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: implement a process for testing the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly testing the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: implement a process for assessing the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly assessing the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: implement a process for assessing the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly assessing the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: implement a process for evaluating the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: implement a process for evaluating the effectiveness of security measures
units.scope: technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing
units.condition: as appropriate
units.temporal: regularly
units.proposition: The processor shall, as appropriate, implement a process for regularly evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of processing.

units.action: take into account the risks presented by processing when assessing the appropriate level of security
units.scope: processing of personal data (transmitted, stored or otherwise processed)
units.condition: when assessing the appropriate level of security
units.proposition: The controller shall, when assessing the appropriate level of security, take into account the risks presented by processing, in particular from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to personal data transmitted, stored or otherwise processed.

units.action: take into account the risks presented by processing when assessing the appropriate level of security
units.scope: processing of personal data (transmitted, stored or otherwise processed)
units.condition: when assessing the appropriate level of security
units.proposition: The processor shall, when assessing the appropriate level of security, take into account the risks presented by processing, in particular from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to personal data transmitted, stored or otherwise processed.

units.action: use adherence as an element to demonstrate compliance with paragraph 1
units.scope: compliance with Article 32(1) security requirements
units.condition: adherence is to an approved Article 40 code of conduct or an approved Article 42 certification mechanism
units.proposition: The controller may use adherence to an approved code of conduct (Article 40) or an approved certification mechanism (Article 42) as an element to demonstrate compliance with paragraph 1.

units.action: use adherence as an element to demonstrate compliance with paragraph 1
units.scope: compliance with Article 32(1) security requirements
units.condition: adherence is to an approved Article 40 code of conduct or an approved Article 42 certification mechanism
units.proposition: The processor may use adherence to an approved code of conduct (Article 40) or an approved certification mechanism (Article 42) as an element to demonstrate compliance with paragraph 1.

units.action: take steps to ensure that persons acting under its authority who have access to personal data do not process them except on the controller's instructions
units.scope: natural persons acting under the controller's authority who have access to personal data
units.exception: unless required by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The controller shall take steps to ensure that any natural person acting under its authority who has access to personal data does not process them except on the controller's instructions, unless required by Union or Member State law.

units.action: take steps to ensure that persons acting under its authority who have access to personal data do not process them except on the controller's instructions
units.scope: natural persons acting under the processor's authority who have access to personal data
units.exception: unless required by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The processor shall take steps to ensure that any natural person acting under its authority who has access to personal data does not process them except on the controller's instructions, unless required by Union or Member State law.

units.action: give advice
units.scope: on the processing operations referred to in Article 36(2)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall give advice on the processing operations referred to in Article 36(2).

units.action: encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(1)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(1).

units.action: provide an opinion on codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall provide an opinion on codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(5).

units.action: approve codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(5)
units.condition: where the codes of conduct provide sufficient safeguards
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall approve codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(5) where the codes provide sufficient safeguards.

units.action: encourage the establishment of data protection certification mechanisms and of data protection seals and marks
units.scope: pursuant to Article 42(1)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall encourage the establishment of data protection certification mechanisms and of data protection seals and marks pursuant to Article 42(1).

units.action: approve the criteria of certification
units.scope: pursuant to Article 42(5)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall approve the criteria of certification pursuant to Article 42(5).

units.action: carry out a review of certifications issued
units.scope: in accordance with Article 42(7)
units.condition: where applicable
units.temporal: periodic
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, where applicable, carry out a periodic review of certifications issued in accordance with Article 42(7).

units.action: draft the criteria for accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 41
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall draft the criteria for accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct pursuant to Article 41.

units.action: publish the criteria for accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 41
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall publish the criteria for accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct pursuant to Article 41.

units.ru_label: Draft accreditation criteria for cert bodies
units.action: draft the criteria for accreditation of a certification body
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall draft the criteria for accreditation of a certification body pursuant to Article 43.

units.ru_label: Publish accreditation criteria for cert bodies
units.action: publish the criteria for accreditation of a certification body
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall publish the criteria for accreditation of a certification body pursuant to Article 43.

units.action: conduct the accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 41
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall conduct the accreditation of a body for monitoring codes of conduct pursuant to Article 41.

units.action: conduct the accreditation of a certification body
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall conduct the accreditation of a certification body pursuant to Article 43.

units.action: authorise contractual clauses and provisions
units.scope: referred to in Article 46(3)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall authorise the contractual clauses and provisions referred to in Article 46(3).

units.action: approve binding corporate rules
units.scope: pursuant to Article 47
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall approve binding corporate rules pursuant to Article 47.

units.action: contribute to the activities of the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall contribute to the activities of the European Data Protection Board.

units.action: keep internal records of infringements of this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall keep internal records of infringements of this Regulation.

units.action: keep internal records of measures taken
units.scope: in accordance with Article 58(2)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall keep internal records of measures taken in accordance with Article 58(2).

units.action: fulfil any other tasks related to the protection of personal data
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall fulfil any other tasks related to the protection of personal data.

units.action: facilitate the submission of complaints
units.scope: complaints referred to in point (f) of paragraph 1
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall facilitate the submission of complaints referred to in point (f) of paragraph 1.

units.action: ensure that any complaint submission form can also be completed electronically
units.condition: when using a complaint submission form as a facilitation measure
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when using a complaint submission form as a facilitation measure, ensure that it can also be completed electronically.

units.ru_label: Do not exclude other means for complaints
units.action: exclude other means of communication for the submission of complaints
units.scope: submission of complaints
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall not exclude other means of communication for the submission of complaints.

units.action: perform its tasks free of charge for specified persons
units.scope: for the data subject and, where applicable, for the data protection officer
units.proposition: The performance of the tasks of each supervisory authority shall be free of charge for the data subject and, where applicable, for the data protection officer.

units.ru_label: Charge fee for unfounded or excessive requests
units.action: charge a fee
units.scope: a reasonable fee based on administrative costs
units.condition: where requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character
units.proposition: Where requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character, the supervisory authority may charge a reasonable fee based on administrative costs.

units.action: refuse to act on a request
units.scope: requests that are manifestly unfounded or excessive
units.condition: where requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character
units.proposition: Where requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of their repetitive character, the supervisory authority may refuse to act on the request.

units.ru_label: Burden of proof for unfounded or excessive
units.action: bear the burden of demonstrating the manifestly unfounded or excessive character of the request
units.condition: when relying on the ground that a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall bear the burden of demonstrating the manifestly unfounded or excessive character of the request when relying on that ground.

units.action: communicate the personal data breach to the data subject
units.scope: communication of personal data breaches to data subjects
units.condition: a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.exception: communication is not required if: (a) appropriate technical and organisational protection measures were implemented and applied to the affected personal data (e.g., encryption rendering data unintelligible to unauthorised persons); (b) subsequent measures ensure the high risk is no longer likely to materialise; or (c) individual communication would involve disproportionate effort
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: When a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall communicate the personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay, unless an exception in Article 34(3) applies.

units.action: describe in clear and plain language the nature of the personal data breach in the communication
units.scope: content of the communication to data subjects under Article 34(1)
units.condition: when communicating a personal data breach to data subjects pursuant to Article 34(1)
units.proposition: When communicating a personal data breach to the data subject pursuant to Article 34(1), the controller shall describe in clear and plain language the nature of the personal data breach.

units.action: include at least the information and measures referred to in Article 33(3)(b), (c) and (d) in the communication
units.scope: content of the communication to data subjects under Article 34(1)
units.condition: when communicating a personal data breach to data subjects pursuant to Article 34(1)
units.proposition: When communicating a personal data breach to the data subject pursuant to Article 34(1), the controller shall include at least the information and measures referred to in points (b), (c) and (d) of Article 33(3).

units.action: make a public communication or take a similar measure to inform data subjects in an equally effective manner
units.scope: substitute for individual communication to data subjects about a personal data breach
units.condition: a personal data breach would otherwise trigger Article 34(1) communication but individual communication would involve disproportionate effort
units.proposition: If individual communication to data subjects about a personal data breach would involve disproportionate effort, the controller shall instead make a public communication or take a similar measure whereby the data subjects are informed in an equally effective manner.

units.action: require the controller to communicate the personal data breach to the data subject
units.scope: oversight of breach communication to data subjects
units.condition: the controller has not already communicated the personal data breach to the data subject and the supervisory authority has considered the likelihood of the breach resulting in a high risk
units.proposition: If the controller has not already communicated the personal data breach to the data subject, the supervisory authority, having considered the likelihood of the breach resulting in a high risk, may require the controller to do so.

units.action: decide that any of the conditions in Article 34(3) are met
units.scope: determination of exceptions to breach communication
units.condition: the controller has not already communicated the personal data breach to the data subject and the supervisory authority has considered the likelihood of the breach resulting in a high risk
units.proposition: If the controller has not already communicated the personal data breach to the data subject, the supervisory authority, having considered the likelihood of the breach resulting in a high risk, may decide that any of the conditions referred to in Article 34(3) are met.

units.action: carry out an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing operations on the protection of personal data (DPIA)
units.scope: data protection impact assessment (DPIA) requirement
units.condition: a type of processing, taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing (in particular using new technologies), is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 to 7 do not apply if processing under Article 6(1)(c) or (e) has a legal basis in Union or Member State law that regulates the specific operation(s) and a DPIA has already been carried out as part of a general impact assessment for that legal basis, unless a Member State deems it necessary to carry out such an assessment prior to processing activities
units.temporal: prior to the processing
units.proposition: Where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall, prior to the processing, carry out a data protection impact assessment of the envisaged processing operations, subject to the exception in Article 35(10).

units.action: address a set of similar processing operations that present similar high risks in a single data protection impact assessment
units.scope: scope of a DPIA
units.condition: the processing operations are similar and present similar high risks
units.proposition: A controller may address a set of similar processing operations that present similar high risks in a single data protection impact assessment.

units.action: seek the advice of the data protection officer when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.scope: DPIA process governance
units.condition: a data protection officer has been designated
units.temporal: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.proposition: Where designated, the controller shall seek the advice of the data protection officer when carrying out a data protection impact assessment.

units.action: carry out a data protection impact assessment
units.scope: systematic and extensive evaluation based on automated processing
units.condition: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons is based on automated processing, including profiling, and decisions based on it produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
units.temporal: prior to the processing
units.proposition: The controller shall carry out a data protection impact assessment prior to processing where there is a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.

units.action: carry out a data protection impact assessment
units.scope: large-scale processing of special categories of data or criminal conviction/offence data
units.condition: processing on a large scale of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1) or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10
units.temporal: prior to the processing
units.proposition: The controller shall carry out a data protection impact assessment prior to processing where there is processing on a large scale of special categories of data under Article 9(1) or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10.

units.action: carry out a data protection impact assessment
units.scope: systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area
units.condition: systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area on a large scale
units.temporal: prior to the processing
units.proposition: The controller shall carry out a data protection impact assessment prior to processing where there is systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area on a large scale.

units.action: establish a list of the kinds of processing operations that are subject to the requirement for a DPIA under Article 35(1)
units.scope: lists of processing operations subject to DPIA
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall establish a list of the kinds of processing operations that are subject to the requirement for a data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35(1).

units.action: make public the list of processing operations subject to a DPIA
units.scope: publication of lists under Article 35(4)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall make public the list of the kinds of processing operations that are subject to the requirement for a data protection impact assessment.

units.action: communicate the lists of processing operations subject to a DPIA to the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: communication of lists to the Board
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall communicate the lists referred to in Article 35(4) to the European Data Protection Board.

units.action: establish a list of the kinds of processing operations for which no data protection impact assessment is required
units.scope: lists of processing operations exempt from DPIA
units.proposition: The supervisory authority may establish a list of the kinds of processing operations for which no data protection impact assessment is required.

units.action: make public the list of processing operations for which no DPIA is required
units.scope: publication of lists under Article 35(5)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority may make public the list of the kinds of processing operations for which no data protection impact assessment is required.

units.action: communicate the lists of processing operations for which no DPIA is required to the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: communication of no-DPIA lists to the Board
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall communicate the lists referred to in Article 35(5) to the European Data Protection Board.

units.action: apply the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63
units.scope: adoption of DPIA-related lists under Article 35(4) and (5)
units.condition: the lists involve processing activities related to offering goods or services to data subjects or to monitoring their behaviour in several Member States, or may substantially affect the free movement of personal data within the Union
units.temporal: prior to the adoption of the lists referred to in Article 35(4) and (5)
units.proposition: Prior to adopting the lists referred to in Article 35(4) and (5), the competent supervisory authority shall apply the consistency mechanism where such lists involve cross-border offerings or monitoring, or may substantially affect the free movement of personal data within the Union.

units.action: include a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller
units.scope: content requirements of a DPIA
units.condition: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.proposition: A data protection impact assessment shall contain at least a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller.

units.action: include an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes
units.scope: content requirements of a DPIA
units.condition: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.proposition: A data protection impact assessment shall contain at least an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes.

units.action: include an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects
units.scope: content requirements of a DPIA
units.condition: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.proposition: A data protection impact assessment shall contain at least an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects referred to in Article 35(1).

units.action: include the measures envisaged to address the risks, including safeguards, security measures and mechanisms to ensure the protection of personal data and to demonstrate compliance, taking into account the rights and legitimate interests of data subjects and other persons concerned
units.scope: content requirements of a DPIA
units.condition: when carrying out a data protection impact assessment
units.proposition: A data protection impact assessment shall contain at least the measures envisaged to address the risks, including safeguards, security measures and mechanisms to ensure the protection of personal data and to demonstrate compliance with the Regulation, taking into account the rights and legitimate interests of data subjects and other persons concerned.

units.action: take compliance with approved codes of conduct into due account in assessing the impact of processing operations
units.scope: assessment of processing impact, in particular for DPIA
units.condition: assessing the impact of processing operations performed by controllers or processors that comply with approved codes of conduct referred to in Article 40
units.proposition: Compliance with approved codes of conduct shall be taken into due account by the controller when assessing the impact of processing operations, in particular for the purposes of a data protection impact assessment.

units.action: seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing
units.scope: stakeholder consultation for DPIA
units.condition: where appropriate
units.exception: without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations
units.proposition: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.

units.action: deem it necessary to carry out a data protection impact assessment prior to processing activities so that the requirements in Article 35(1) to (7) apply
units.scope: override of the non-application of DPIA obligations where a general impact assessment already exists
units.condition: processing under Article 6(1)(c) or (e) has a legal basis in Union or Member State law that regulates the specific operation(s), and a DPIA has already been carried out as part of a general impact assessment for that legal basis
units.temporal: prior to processing activities
units.proposition: A Member State may deem it necessary to carry out a data protection impact assessment prior to processing activities, thereby applying Article 35(1) to (7) even where a general impact assessment has already been carried out for processing under Article 6(1)(c) or (e).

units.action: carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment
units.scope: post-DPIA review
units.condition: where necessary
units.temporal: at least when there is a change of the risk represented by the processing operations
units.proposition: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment, at least when there is a change of the risk represented by the processing operations.

units.action: consult the supervisory authority
units.scope: intended processing
units.condition: where a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 indicates the processing would result in a high risk in the absence of measures taken by the controller to mitigate the risk
units.temporal: prior to processing
units.proposition: The controller must consult the supervisory authority before processing when a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 indicates that the processing would result in a high risk absent mitigating measures.

units.ru_label: SA must advise when intended processing would infringe
units.action: provide written advice to the controller and, where applicable, the processor
units.scope: intended processing referred to in paragraph 1
units.condition: where the supervisory authority is of the opinion that the intended processing would infringe the GDPR, in particular where the controller has insufficiently identified or mitigated the risk
units.temporal: within up to eight weeks of receipt of the request for consultation
units.proposition: Where it considers the intended processing referred to in paragraph 1 would infringe the GDPR, the supervisory authority must provide written advice to the controller and, where applicable, the processor within up to eight weeks of receiving the consultation request.

units.ru_label: SA may use Article 58 powers in consultation
units.action: use any of its powers referred to in Article 58
units.scope: intended processing referred to in paragraph 1
units.condition: where the supervisory authority is of the opinion that the intended processing would infringe the GDPR
units.proposition: Where it considers the intended processing referred to in paragraph 1 would infringe the GDPR, the supervisory authority may use any of its powers referred to in Article 58.

units.ru_label: SA may extend advice period by six weeks
units.action: extend the initial advice period by six weeks
units.scope: consultation under paragraph 1
units.condition: taking into account the complexity of the intended processing
units.proposition: The supervisory authority may extend the initial eight-week period to provide advice by six weeks, taking into account the complexity of the intended processing.

units.ru_label: SA must inform of extension and reasons
units.action: inform the controller and, where applicable, the processor, of any such extension together with the reasons for the delay
units.scope: consultation under paragraph 1
units.condition: when it extends the period for providing advice
units.temporal: within one month of receipt of the request for consultation
units.proposition: If it extends the advice period, the supervisory authority must inform the controller and, where applicable, the processor of the extension and the reasons for the delay within one month of receiving the consultation request.

units.ru_label: SA may suspend consultation time limits until info obtained
units.action: suspend the consultation time limits
units.scope: consultation under paragraph 1
units.condition: where it has requested information for the purposes of the consultation
units.temporal: until the supervisory authority has obtained the requested information
units.proposition: The supervisory authority may suspend the consultation time limits until it has obtained information it requested for the purposes of the consultation.

units.action: provide the supervisory authority with the respective responsibilities of the controller, joint controllers and processors involved in the processing
units.scope: processing, in particular within a group of undertakings
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, where applicable
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must, where applicable, provide the supervisory authority with the respective responsibilities of the controller, joint controllers and processors involved in the processing, in particular for processing within a group of undertakings.

units.ru_label: Controller must provide purposes and means
units.action: provide the supervisory authority with the purposes and means of the intended processing
units.scope: intended processing
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must provide the supervisory authority with the purposes and means of the intended processing.

units.ru_label: Controller must provide measures and safeguards
units.action: provide the supervisory authority with the measures and safeguards provided to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects pursuant to the GDPR
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must provide the supervisory authority with the measures and safeguards provided to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects pursuant to the GDPR.

units.ru_label: Controller must provide DPO contact details
units.action: provide the supervisory authority with the contact details of the data protection officer
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, where applicable
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must, where applicable, provide the supervisory authority with the contact details of the data protection officer.

units.action: provide the supervisory authority with the data protection impact assessment provided for in Article 35
units.scope: DPIA under Article 35
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must provide the supervisory authority with the data protection impact assessment provided for in Article 35.

units.ru_label: Controller must provide other requested information
units.action: provide the supervisory authority with any other information requested by the supervisory authority
units.condition: when consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1 and when the supervisory authority requests such information
units.proposition: When consulting the supervisory authority under paragraph 1, the controller must provide the supervisory authority with any other information it requests.

units.ru_label: Member States must consult SA on draft measures relating to processing
units.action: consult the supervisory authority
units.scope: preparation of a proposal for a legislative measure to be adopted by a national parliament or of a regulatory measure based on such a legislative measure that relates to processing
units.temporal: during the preparation of the measure
units.proposition: Member States must consult the supervisory authority during the preparation of a proposal for a legislative measure to be adopted by a national parliament or a regulatory measure based on such a legislative measure that relates to processing.

units.ru_label: Member States may require consultation for public-interest processing
units.action: require controllers to consult the supervisory authority
units.scope: processing by a controller for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest, including processing in relation to social protection and public health
units.exception: Notwithstanding paragraph 1
units.proposition: Member State law may require controllers to consult the supervisory authority in relation to processing for the performance of a task in the public interest, including processing related to social protection and public health.

units.ru_label: Member States may require prior authorisation for public-interest processing
units.action: require controllers to obtain prior authorisation from the supervisory authority
units.scope: processing by a controller for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest, including processing in relation to social protection and public health
units.exception: Notwithstanding paragraph 1
units.proposition: Member State law may require controllers to obtain prior authorisation from the supervisory authority in relation to processing for the performance of a task in the public interest, including processing related to social protection and public health.

units.action: inform the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing of their data protection obligations
units.scope: obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to inform the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing of their obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions.

units.action: advise the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing about their data protection obligations
units.scope: obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to advise the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing about their obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions.

units.action: monitor compliance with legal and internal data protection requirements
units.scope: GDPR, other Union or Member State data protection provisions, and the controller’s or processor’s policies on personal data protection, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of staff involved in processing operations, and related audits
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to monitor compliance with the GDPR, with other Union or Member State data protection provisions, and with the controller’s or processor’s policies on personal data protection, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of staff involved in processing operations, and the related audits.

units.action: provide advice as regards the data protection impact assessment
units.scope: the data protection impact assessment (DPIA)
units.condition: where requested
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged, where requested, to provide advice as regards the data protection impact assessment.

units.action: monitor the performance of the data protection impact assessment
units.scope: pursuant to Article 35
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to monitor the performance of the data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35.

units.action: cooperate with the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to cooperate with the supervisory authority.

units.action: act as the contact point for the supervisory authority
units.scope: issues relating to processing, including the prior consultation referred to in Article 36
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to act as the contact point for the supervisory authority on issues relating to processing, including the prior consultation referred to in Article 36.

units.action: consult with the supervisory authority
units.scope: with regard to any other matter
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged, where appropriate, to consult with the supervisory authority with regard to any other matter.

units.action: have due regard to the risk associated with processing operations
units.scope: taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing
units.condition: in the performance of their tasks
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged, in the performance of their tasks, to have due regard to the risk associated with processing operations, taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing.

units.action: ensure that the data protection officer is properly involved in issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.scope: all issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer is properly and timely involved in all issues relating to the protection of personal data.

units.action: ensure that the data protection officer is properly involved in issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.scope: all issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.temporal: in a timely manner
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer is properly and timely involved in all issues relating to the protection of personal data.

units.ru_label: Provide resources for DPO tasks - controller
units.action: provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.ru_label: Provide resources for DPO tasks - processor
units.action: provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.ru_label: Provide DPO access to data/operations - controller
units.action: provide the data protection officer access to personal data and to processing operations
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data protection officer access to personal data and to processing operations.

units.ru_label: Provide DPO access to data/operations - processor
units.action: provide the data protection officer access to personal data and to processing operations
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to provide the data protection officer access to personal data and to processing operations.

units.action: provide the resources necessary to maintain the data protection officer’s expert knowledge
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the resources necessary to maintain the data protection officer’s expert knowledge.

units.action: provide the resources necessary to maintain the data protection officer’s expert knowledge
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to provide the resources necessary to maintain the data protection officer’s expert knowledge.

units.ru_label: Ensure no instructions to DPO - controller
units.action: ensure that the data protection officer does not receive any instructions regarding the exercise of tasks
units.scope: regarding the exercise of the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer does not receive any instructions regarding the exercise of the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.ru_label: Ensure no instructions to DPO - processor
units.action: ensure that the data protection officer does not receive any instructions regarding the exercise of tasks
units.scope: regarding the exercise of the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer does not receive any instructions regarding the exercise of the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.ru_label: No dismissal of DPO for tasks - controller
units.action: dismiss the data protection officer
units.condition: for performing his or her tasks
units.proposition: The controller is prohibited from dismissing the data protection officer for performing his or her tasks.

units.ru_label: No penalisation of DPO for tasks - controller
units.action: penalise the data protection officer
units.condition: for performing his or her tasks
units.proposition: The controller is prohibited from penalising the data protection officer for performing his or her tasks.

units.ru_label: No dismissal of DPO for tasks - processor
units.action: dismiss the data protection officer
units.condition: for performing his or her tasks
units.proposition: The processor is prohibited from dismissing the data protection officer for performing his or her tasks.

units.ru_label: No penalisation of DPO for tasks - processor
units.action: penalise the data protection officer
units.condition: for performing his or her tasks
units.proposition: The processor is prohibited from penalising the data protection officer for performing his or her tasks.

units.action: directly report to the highest management level of the controller or the processor
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to directly report to the highest management level of the controller or the processor.

units.action: contact the data protection officer
units.scope: with regard to all issues related to processing of their personal data and to the exercise of their rights under this Regulation
units.proposition: Data subjects have the right to contact the data protection officer with regard to all issues related to processing of their personal data and to the exercise of their rights under this Regulation.

units.action: observe secrecy or confidentiality concerning the performance of his or her tasks
units.condition: in accordance with Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged, in accordance with Union or Member State law, to observe secrecy or confidentiality concerning the performance of his or her tasks.

units.action: fulfil other tasks and duties
units.proposition: The data protection officer is permitted to fulfil other tasks and duties.

units.ru_label: Ensure no conflict of interests - controller
units.action: ensure that any other tasks and duties assigned to the data protection officer do not result in a conflict of interests
units.scope: with respect to other tasks and duties fulfilled by the data protection officer
units.condition: where the data protection officer fulfils other tasks and duties
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that any other tasks and duties assigned to the data protection officer do not result in a conflict of interests.

units.ru_label: Ensure no conflict of interests - processor
units.action: ensure that any other tasks and duties assigned to the data protection officer do not result in a conflict of interests
units.scope: with respect to other tasks and duties fulfilled by the data protection officer
units.condition: where the data protection officer fulfils other tasks and duties
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to ensure that any other tasks and duties assigned to the data protection officer do not result in a conflict of interests.

units.addressee: body with appropriate expertise accredited by the competent supervisory authority
units.action: carry out monitoring of compliance with a code of conduct
units.scope: codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40
units.condition: the body has an appropriate level of expertise in relation to the subject-matter of the code and is accredited for that purpose by the competent supervisory authority
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks and powers of the competent supervisory authority under Articles 57 and 58; this Article does not apply to processing carried out by public authorities and bodies
units.proposition: An accredited body with appropriate expertise may carry out monitoring of compliance with a code of conduct pursuant to Article 40.

units.action: accredit a body to monitor compliance with a code of conduct
units.scope: accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1)
units.condition: the body has demonstrated its independence and expertise to the satisfaction of the competent supervisory authority; has established procedures to assess controllers' and processors' eligibility to apply the code, to monitor their compliance with its provisions, and to periodically review its operation; has established procedures and structures to handle complaints about infringements or implementation of the code and made them transparent to data subjects and the public; and has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the competent supervisory authority that its tasks and duties do not result in a conflict of interests
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority has the power to accredit a body to monitor compliance with a code of conduct when the body meets the criteria in Article 41(2)(a)–(d).

units.action: submit the draft criteria for accreditation of a monitoring body to the Board
units.scope: consistency mechanism under Article 63 for accreditation criteria of bodies referred to in Article 41(1)
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority shall submit the draft criteria for accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1) to the Board pursuant to Article 63.

units.action: take appropriate action in cases of infringement of the code by a controller or processor, including suspension or exclusion of the controller or processor from the code
units.condition: subject to appropriate safeguards; an infringement of the code by a controller or processor has occurred
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks and powers of the competent supervisory authority and the provisions of Chapter VIII; this Article does not apply to processing carried out by public authorities and bodies
units.proposition: A body referred to in Article 41(1) shall, subject to appropriate safeguards, take appropriate action in cases of infringement of the code by a controller or processor, including suspension or exclusion from the code.

units.action: inform the competent supervisory authority of the actions taken and the reasons for taking them
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks and powers of the competent supervisory authority and the provisions of Chapter VIII; this Article does not apply to processing carried out by public authorities and bodies
units.temporal: after taking action in response to an infringement of the code under Article 41(4)
units.proposition: A body referred to in Article 41(1) shall inform the competent supervisory authority of the actions it takes in response to code infringements and the reasons for those actions.

units.action: revoke the accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1)
units.condition: the conditions for accreditation are not or are no longer met, or actions taken by the body infringe this Regulation
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority shall revoke the accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1) if the accreditation conditions are not or are no longer met or if the body’s actions infringe the GDPR.

units.addressee: Member States; supervisory authorities; the European Data Protection Board; the European Commission
units.action: encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to contribute to the proper application of the Regulation
units.scope: Taking account of the specific features of the various processing sectors and the specific needs of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises
units.proposition: Member States, supervisory authorities, the Board and the Commission are obliged to encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct that contribute to the proper application of the GDPR, taking account of sectoral features and the needs of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: prepare codes of conduct to specify the application of the Regulation
units.scope: Topics may include: fair and transparent processing; legitimate interests in specific contexts; collection of personal data; pseudonymisation; information to the public and data subjects; exercise of data subjects’ rights; information provided to and protection of children and obtaining parental consent; measures and procedures under Articles 24 and 25 and security measures under Article 32; breach notification to supervisory authorities and communication to data subjects; transfers to third countries or international organisations; and out-of-court and other dispute resolution procedures between controllers and data subjects
units.exception: Without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are permitted to prepare codes of conduct to specify the application of the GDPR on the listed topics, without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: amend existing codes of conduct to specify the application of the Regulation
units.scope: Same topical scope as for preparing codes: items (a) to (k)
units.exception: Without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are permitted to amend existing codes of conduct to specify the application of the GDPR on the listed topics, without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: extend existing codes of conduct to specify the application of the Regulation
units.scope: Same topical scope as for preparing codes: items (a) to (k)
units.exception: Without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are permitted to extend existing codes of conduct to specify the application of the GDPR on the listed topics, without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79.

units.addressee: Controllers or processors not subject to the Regulation pursuant to Article 3
units.action: adhere to approved and generally valid codes of conduct
units.scope: To provide appropriate safeguards for personal data transfers to third countries or international organisations under Article 46(2)(e)
units.condition: The code of conduct is approved pursuant to paragraph 5 and has general validity pursuant to paragraph 9
units.proposition: Controllers or processors not subject to the GDPR are permitted to adhere to codes of conduct approved under paragraph 5 and having general validity under paragraph 9 to provide appropriate safeguards for transfers under Article 46(2)(e).

units.addressee: Controllers or processors not subject to the Regulation pursuant to Article 3 that adhere to such codes of conduct
units.action: make binding and enforceable commitments via contractual or other legally binding instruments to apply the appropriate safeguards, including with regard to the rights of data subjects
units.condition: When adhering to approved and generally valid codes of conduct to provide appropriate safeguards for transfers under Article 46(2)(e)
units.proposition: Controllers or processors not subject to the GDPR that adhere to approved and generally valid codes of conduct to provide safeguards for transfers under Article 46(2)(e) are obliged to make binding and enforceable commitments via contractual or other legally binding instruments to apply those safeguards, including regarding data subjects’ rights.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies referred to in paragraph 2 that prepare codes of conduct
units.action: ensure the code of conduct contains mechanisms enabling the Article 41(1) body to carry out mandatory monitoring of compliance with the code by controllers or processors that undertake to apply it
units.condition: For codes of conduct referred to in paragraph 2
units.exception: Without prejudice to the tasks and powers of supervisory authorities competent under Articles 55 and 56
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies that prepare codes of conduct are obliged to ensure the code contains mechanisms enabling the Article 41(1) body to carry out mandatory monitoring of compliance by those controllers or processors that undertake to apply it, without prejudice to the powers of competent supervisory authorities.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies referred to in paragraph 2
units.action: submit the draft code of conduct, amendment, or extension to the supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 55
units.condition: They intend to prepare a code of conduct or to amend or extend an existing code
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies that intend to prepare, amend, or extend a code of conduct are obliged to submit the draft to the supervisory authority competent under Article 55.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 55
units.action: provide an opinion on whether the draft code, amendment, or extension complies with the Regulation
units.condition: Upon receipt of a draft code of conduct, amendment, or extension submitted under paragraph 5
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to provide an opinion on whether the submitted draft code, amendment, or extension complies with the GDPR.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 55
units.action: approve the draft code, amendment, or extension
units.condition: If it finds that the draft code, amendment, or extension provides sufficient appropriate safeguards
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to approve the draft code, amendment, or extension if it finds that it provides sufficient appropriate safeguards.

units.action: register the code of conduct
units.condition: The draft code, amendment, or extension is approved in accordance with paragraph 5 and the code does not relate to processing activities in several Member States
units.proposition: The supervisory authority is obliged to register the code of conduct when it is approved under paragraph 5 and does not relate to processing activities in several Member States.

units.action: publish the code of conduct
units.condition: The draft code, amendment, or extension is approved in accordance with paragraph 5 and the code does not relate to processing activities in several Member States
units.proposition: The supervisory authority is obliged to publish the code of conduct when it is approved under paragraph 5 and does not relate to processing activities in several Member States.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 55
units.action: submit the draft code, amendment, or extension to the Board under the Article 63 consistency procedure
units.condition: The draft code of conduct relates to processing activities in several Member States
units.temporal: Before approving the draft code, amendment, or extension
