units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to submit a multi‑state draft code, amendment, or extension to the Board under the Article 63 procedure before approving it.

units.action: provide an opinion on whether the draft code, amendment, or extension complies with the Regulation or, in the situation under paragraph 3, provides appropriate safeguards
units.condition: Upon submission of a multi‑state draft code, amendment, or extension under the Article 63 procedure pursuant to paragraph 7
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to provide an opinion on whether the multi‑state draft code, amendment, or extension complies with the GDPR or, in the situation under paragraph 3, provides appropriate safeguards.

units.action: submit its opinion to the European Commission
units.condition: The opinion under paragraph 7 confirms that the draft code, amendment, or extension complies with the Regulation or, in the situation under paragraph 3, provides appropriate safeguards
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to submit its opinion to the Commission when the opinion under paragraph 7 confirms compliance or, in the situation under paragraph 3, appropriate safeguards.

units.action: decide, by implementing acts, that an approved code of conduct, amendment, or extension submitted under paragraph 8 has general validity within the Union
units.condition: An approved code of conduct, amendment, or extension is submitted to the Commission pursuant to paragraph 8
units.proposition: The Commission has the power to decide by implementing acts that an approved code of conduct, amendment, or extension submitted under paragraph 8 has general validity within the Union.

units.action: adopt the implementing acts deciding general validity in accordance with the examination procedure set out in Article 93(2)
units.condition: When adopting implementing acts deciding on general validity under paragraph 9
units.proposition: The Commission is obliged to adopt the implementing acts deciding on general validity in accordance with the examination procedure in Article 93(2).

units.action: ensure appropriate publicity for approved codes of conduct decided as having general validity
units.condition: The codes have been decided as having general validity in accordance with paragraph 9
units.proposition: The Commission is obliged to ensure appropriate publicity for approved codes of conduct that have been decided as having general validity under paragraph 9.

units.action: collate all approved codes of conduct, amendments, and extensions in a register
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to collate all approved codes of conduct, amendments, and extensions in a register.

units.action: make all approved codes of conduct, amendments, and extensions publicly available by appropriate means
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to make all approved codes of conduct, amendments, and extensions publicly available by appropriate means.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: if any of the following apply: (a) processing is carried out by a public authority or body; (b) the controller’s core activities consist of processing operations that, by virtue of their nature, scope and/or purposes, require regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale; or (c) the controller’s core activities consist of large-scale processing of special categories of data under Article 9 and personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10
units.exception: for point (a), except for courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to designate a data protection officer when any trigger in Article 37(1)(a)–(c) applies, except that courts acting in their judicial capacity are excluded from point (a).

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: if any of the following apply: (a) processing is carried out by a public authority or body; (b) the processor’s core activities consist of processing operations that, by virtue of their nature, scope and/or purposes, require regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale; or (c) the processor’s core activities consist of large-scale processing of special categories of data under Article 9 and personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10
units.exception: for point (a), except for courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to designate a data protection officer when any trigger in Article 37(1)(a)–(c) applies, except that courts acting in their judicial capacity are excluded from point (a).

units.action: appoint a single data protection officer for the group
units.condition: provided that a data protection officer is easily accessible from each establishment
units.proposition: A group of undertakings is permitted to appoint a single data protection officer for the group, provided that the data protection officer is easily accessible from each establishment.

units.addressee: public authority or body acting as controller or processor
units.action: designate a single data protection officer for several such authorities or bodies
units.scope: taking account of the organisational structure and size of the authorities or bodies
units.condition: where the controller or the processor is a public authority or body
units.proposition: A public authority or body acting as a controller or processor is permitted to designate a single data protection officer for several such authorities or bodies, taking account of their organisational structure and size.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1)
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1).

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1)
units.proposition: The processor is permitted to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1).

units.addressee: associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1)
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are permitted to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1).

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1), where required by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1) where required by Union or Member State law.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1), where required by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1) where required by Union or Member State law.

units.addressee: associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1), where required by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are obligated to designate a data protection officer in cases other than those referred to in Article 37(1) where required by Union or Member State law.

units.action: act for associations and other bodies representing controllers or processors
units.scope: for the associations and other bodies described in Article 37(4)
units.proposition: A data protection officer is permitted to act for associations and other bodies representing controllers or processors.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.scope: on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to designate a data protection officer on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.scope: on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to designate a data protection officer on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.scope: on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: A group of undertakings is obligated to designate a data protection officer on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.addressee: public authority or body acting as controller or processor
units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.scope: on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: A public authority or body acting as a controller or processor is obligated to designate a data protection officer on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.addressee: associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.scope: on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are obligated to designate a data protection officer on the basis of professional qualities, in particular expert knowledge of data protection law and practices, and the ability to fulfil the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.action: have the data protection officer be a staff member of the controller
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to have the data protection officer be a staff member of the controller.

units.action: have the data protection officer be a staff member of the processor
units.proposition: The processor is permitted to have the data protection officer be a staff member of the processor.

units.action: have the data protection officer fulfil the tasks on the basis of a service contract
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to have the data protection officer fulfil the tasks on the basis of a service contract.

units.action: have the data protection officer fulfil the tasks on the basis of a service contract
units.proposition: The processor is permitted to have the data protection officer fulfil the tasks on the basis of a service contract.

units.action: publish the contact details of the data protection officer
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to publish the contact details of the data protection officer.

units.action: publish the contact details of the data protection officer
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to publish the contact details of the data protection officer.

units.action: communicate the contact details of the data protection officer to the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to communicate the contact details of the data protection officer to the supervisory authority.

units.action: communicate the contact details of the data protection officer to the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to communicate the contact details of the data protection officer to the supervisory authority.

units.action: impose a total administrative fine that exceeds the amount specified for the gravest infringement
units.scope: administrative fines under this Regulation
units.condition: where a controller or processor intentionally or negligently infringes several provisions of this Regulation for the same or linked processing operations
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose a total administrative fine that exceeds the amount specified for the gravest infringement where a controller or processor intentionally or negligently infringes several provisions of this Regulation for the same or linked processing operations.

units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the obligations of the controller and the processor pursuant to Articles 8, 11, 25 to 39, 42 and 43
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the obligations of the controller and the processor pursuant to Articles 8, 11, 25 to 39, 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 10m/2% for certification body duties
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the obligations of the certification body pursuant to Articles 42 and 43
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the obligations of the certification body pursuant to Articles 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 10m/2% for monitoring body duties
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the obligations of the monitoring body pursuant to Article 41(4)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the obligations of the monitoring body pursuant to Article 41(4).

units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the basic principles for processing, including conditions for consent, pursuant to Articles 5, 6, 7 and 9
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the basic principles for processing, including conditions for consent, pursuant to Articles 5, 6, 7 and 9.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 20m/4% for data subject rights
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the data subjects' rights pursuant to Articles 12 to 22
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the data subjects' rights pursuant to Articles 12 to 22.

units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the transfers of personal data to a recipient in a third country or an international organisation pursuant to Articles 44 to 49
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the transfers of personal data to a recipient in a third country or an international organisation pursuant to Articles 44 to 49.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 20m/4% for MS law under Chapter IX
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of any obligations pursuant to Member State law adopted under Chapter IX
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of any obligations pursuant to Member State law adopted under Chapter IX.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 20m/4% for non-compliance with SA measures or access failure
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for non-compliance with an order, a temporary or definitive limitation on processing, or a suspension of data flows imposed by the supervisory authority pursuant to Article 58(2), or for failure to provide access in violation of Article 58(1)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for non-compliance with an order, a temporary or definitive limitation on processing, or a suspension of data flows imposed by the supervisory authority pursuant to Article 58(2), or for failure to provide access in violation of Article 58(1).

units.ru_label: Cap fines 20m/4% for non-compliance with SA order (58(2))
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article
units.condition: for non-compliance with an order by the supervisory authority as referred to in Article 58(2)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for non-compliance with an order by the supervisory authority as referred to in Article 58(2).

units.ru_label: MS may set rules on fining public authorities
units.action: lay down the rules on whether and to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and bodies established in that Member State
units.exception: without prejudice to the corrective powers of supervisory authorities pursuant to Article 58(2)
units.proposition: A Member State may lay down the rules on whether and to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and bodies established in that Member State, without prejudice to the corrective powers of supervisory authorities pursuant to Article 58(2).

units.action: subject the exercise of its powers under this Article to appropriate procedural safeguards, including effective judicial remedy and due process, in accordance with Union and Member State law
units.scope: exercise of powers under this Article
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall subject the exercise of its powers under this Article to appropriate procedural safeguards, including effective judicial remedy and due process, in accordance with Union and Member State law.

units.ru_label: MS may use court-imposed fine mechanism
units.action: apply this Article so that the fine is initiated by the competent supervisory authority and imposed by competent national courts
units.condition: where the legal system of the Member State does not provide for administrative fines and provided that the legal remedies are effective and have an equivalent effect to the administrative fines imposed by supervisory authorities
units.proposition: Where the legal system of the Member State does not provide for administrative fines, the Member State may apply this Article so that the fine is initiated by the competent supervisory authority and imposed by competent national courts, provided that the legal remedies are effective and have an equivalent effect to the administrative fines imposed by supervisory authorities.

units.ru_label: Fines must be effective proportionate dissuasive
units.addressee: supervisory authorities and competent national courts imposing fines
units.action: ensure that fines imposed are effective, proportionate and dissuasive
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities and competent national courts imposing fines shall ensure that fines imposed are effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

units.ru_label: MS notify initial laws by 25 May 2018
units.addressee: Member States referred to in paragraph 9
units.action: notify to the Commission the provisions of their laws adopted pursuant to paragraph 9
units.temporal: by 25 May 2018
units.proposition: Member States referred to in paragraph 9 shall notify to the Commission the provisions of their laws adopted pursuant to that paragraph by 25 May 2018.

units.ru_label: MS notify subsequent amendments without delay
units.addressee: Member States referred to in paragraph 9
units.action: notify to the Commission any subsequent amendment law or amendment affecting the notified provisions
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: Member States referred to in paragraph 9 shall notify to the Commission, without delay, any subsequent amendment law or amendment affecting the notified provisions.

units.ru_label: No transfer by controller without Chapter V compliance
units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers
units.scope: personal data that are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer; includes onward transfers from the third country or international organisation to another third country or international organisation
units.condition: subject to the other provisions of the GDPR
units.exception: when the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with
units.proposition: The controller is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers, unless the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with, subject to the other provisions of the GDPR.

units.ru_label: No transfer by processor without Chapter V compliance
units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers
units.scope: personal data that are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer; includes onward transfers from the third country or international organisation to another third country or international organisation
units.condition: subject to the other provisions of the GDPR
units.exception: when the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with
units.proposition: The processor is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers, unless the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with, subject to the other provisions of the GDPR.

units.ru_label: Controller must apply Chapter V to maintain protection
units.action: apply all provisions in Chapter V
units.scope: in a manner that ensures the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to apply all provisions in Chapter V so as to ensure that the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined.

units.ru_label: Processor must apply Chapter V to maintain protection
units.action: apply all provisions in Chapter V
units.scope: in a manner that ensures the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to apply all provisions in Chapter V so as to ensure that the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation on the basis of an adequacy decision
units.scope: international transfers of personal data under Article 45
units.condition: the European Commission has decided that the destination ensures an adequate level of protection
units.proposition: A controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation where the Commission has decided that the destination ensures an adequate level of protection.

units.action: require any specific authorisation for a transfer based on an adequacy decision
units.scope: transfers of personal data permitted under Article 45(1)
units.condition: the transfer is based on a Commission adequacy decision
units.proposition: A supervisory authority is prohibited from requiring any specific authorisation for a transfer of personal data that is based on a Commission adequacy decision under Article 45.

units.action: take account of the factors listed in point (a) when assessing adequacy
units.scope: assessment of adequacy of the level of protection in a third country, territory, sector, or international organisation
units.condition: when assessing the adequacy of the level of protection
units.proposition: When assessing the adequacy of the level of protection, the European Commission shall take account of the rule of law, respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms, relevant legislation and its implementation, data protection and professional rules, security measures including onward transfer rules, case-law, and the effectiveness of data subject rights and administrative and judicial redress in the destination.

units.action: take account of the existence and effective functioning of one or more independent supervisory authorities in the destination
units.scope: assessment of adequacy of the level of protection
units.condition: when assessing the adequacy of the level of protection
units.proposition: When assessing the adequacy of the level of protection, the European Commission shall take account of the existence and effective functioning of one or more independent supervisory authorities in the destination with responsibility for ensuring and enforcing compliance, with adequate enforcement powers, for assisting and advising data subjects, and for cooperation with Member State supervisory authorities.

units.action: take account of the destination’s international commitments and other legally binding obligations, including participation in multilateral or regional systems, particularly regarding personal data protection
units.scope: assessment of adequacy of the level of protection
units.condition: when assessing the adequacy of the level of protection
units.proposition: When assessing the adequacy of the level of protection, the European Commission shall take account of the international commitments and other legally binding obligations of the destination, including participation in multilateral or regional systems, in particular in relation to the protection of personal data.

units.action: decide by means of an implementing act that a destination ensures an adequate level of protection
units.scope: third countries, territories or specified sectors within a third country, and international organisations
units.condition: after assessing the adequacy of the level of protection within the meaning of Article 45(2)
units.proposition: After assessing adequacy, the European Commission has the power to decide by implementing act that a third country, a territory or specified sectors within it, or an international organisation ensures an adequate level of protection.

units.action: provide in the implementing act a mechanism for periodic review
units.scope: implementing acts adopting adequacy decisions under Article 45(3)
units.temporal: at least every four years
units.proposition: The European Commission shall ensure that an implementing act adopting an adequacy decision provides for a mechanism for periodic review at least every four years.

units.action: ensure the review mechanism takes into account all relevant developments in the destination
units.scope: periodic review mechanism provided in an adequacy implementing act
units.proposition: The European Commission shall ensure that the periodic review mechanism provided in an adequacy implementing act takes into account all relevant developments in the third country or international organisation.

units.action: specify in the implementing act its territorial and sectoral application
units.scope: implementing acts adopting adequacy decisions under Article 45(3)
units.proposition: The European Commission shall specify in an adequacy implementing act its territorial and sectoral application.

units.action: identify the relevant supervisory authority or authorities in the implementing act
units.scope: implementing acts adopting adequacy decisions under Article 45(3)
units.condition: where applicable
units.proposition: Where applicable, the European Commission shall identify in an adequacy implementing act the supervisory authority or authorities referred to in Article 45(2)(b).

units.action: adopt the implementing act in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2)
units.scope: implementing acts adopting adequacy decisions under Article 45(3)
units.proposition: The European Commission shall adopt an adequacy implementing act in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2).

units.action: monitor developments in third countries and international organisations that could affect the functioning of relevant adequacy decisions
units.scope: decisions adopted pursuant to Article 45(3) and decisions adopted on the basis of Article 25(6) of Directive 95/46/EC
units.temporal: on an ongoing basis
units.proposition: The European Commission shall on an ongoing basis monitor developments in third countries and international organisations that could affect the functioning of adequacy decisions under Article 45(3) and decisions adopted on the basis of Article 25(6) of Directive 95/46/EC.

units.action: repeal, amend or suspend the adequacy decision by means of implementing acts without retroactive effect
units.scope: decisions referred to in Article 45(3)
units.condition: available information, in particular following the periodic review, reveals that the destination no longer ensures an adequate level of protection within the meaning of Article 45(2), and to the extent necessary
units.proposition: Where available information, in particular following the periodic review, reveals that a destination no longer ensures an adequate level of protection, the European Commission shall, to the extent necessary, repeal, amend or suspend the adequacy decision by implementing acts without retroactive effect.

units.action: adopt implementing acts under Article 45(5) in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2)
units.scope: implementing acts adopted under Article 45(5)
units.proposition: The European Commission shall adopt implementing acts under Article 45(5) in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2).

units.action: adopt immediately applicable implementing acts in accordance with Article 93(3)
units.scope: measures under Article 45(5)
units.condition: on duly justified imperative grounds of urgency
units.temporal: immediately
units.proposition: On duly justified imperative grounds of urgency, the European Commission shall adopt immediately applicable implementing acts under Article 45(5) in accordance with Article 93(3).

units.action: enter into consultations with the third country or international organisation to remedy the situation
units.scope: situations giving rise to a decision made pursuant to Article 45(5)
units.condition: following a decision adopted under Article 45(5)
units.proposition: Following a decision under Article 45(5), the European Commission shall enter into consultations with the third country or international organisation with a view to remedying the situation.

units.action: publish a list of destinations for which adequacy is or is no longer ensured
units.scope: third countries, territories, specified sectors within a third country and international organisations covered by adequacy decisions
units.consequence: publication in the Official Journal of the European Union and on the Commission’s website
units.proposition: The European Commission shall publish in the Official Journal of the European Union and on its website a list of third countries, territories, specified sectors and international organisations for which it has decided that an adequate level of protection is or is no longer ensured.

units.ru_label: No recognition of third-country data-transfer orders without agreement
units.action: recognise a judgment or administrative decision requiring a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data
units.scope: Any judgment of a court or tribunal and any decision of an administrative authority of a third country that requires a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data, in any manner within the Union
units.condition: The judgment or decision is not based on an international agreement, in force, between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State
units.exception: Without prejudice to other grounds for transfer pursuant to this Chapter
units.proposition: Do not recognise, in any manner, any judgment or decision of a third-country court, tribunal, or administrative authority that requires a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data if it is not based on an international agreement in force between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State, without prejudice to other grounds for transfer pursuant to this Chapter.

units.ru_label: No enforcement of third-country data-transfer orders without agreement
units.action: enforce a judgment or administrative decision requiring a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data
units.scope: Any judgment of a court or tribunal and any decision of an administrative authority of a third country that requires a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data, in any manner within the Union
units.condition: The judgment or decision is not based on an international agreement, in force, between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State
units.exception: Without prejudice to other grounds for transfer pursuant to this Chapter
units.proposition: Do not enforce, in any manner, any judgment or decision of a third-country court, tribunal, or administrative authority that requires a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data if it is not based on an international agreement in force between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State, without prejudice to other grounds for transfer pursuant to this Chapter.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when none of the derogations in points (a)–(g) of paragraph 1 applies and the conditions for the compelling legitimate interests derogation in paragraph 1 second subparagraph are not fulfilled
units.proposition: The controller or processor is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or an international organisation unless one of the derogations in points (a)–(g) applies or the conditions for the compelling legitimate interests derogation in paragraph 1 second subparagraph are fulfilled.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer after being informed of the possible risks of such transfers due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards
units.exception: does not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer after being informed of the possible risks due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards, except where the transfer is carried out by a public authority in the exercise of its public powers.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the data subject and the controller or for the implementation of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject’s request
units.exception: does not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the data subject and the controller or for the implementation of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject’s request, except where the transfer is carried out by a public authority in the exercise of its public powers.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the interest of the data subject between the controller and another natural or legal person
units.exception: does not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the interest of the data subject between the controller and another natural or legal person, except where the transfer is carried out by a public authority in the exercise of its public powers.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary for important reasons of public interest and the public interest is recognised in Union law or in the law of the Member State to which the controller is subject
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary for important reasons of public interest that are recognised in Union law or in the law of the Member State to which the controller is subject.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of other persons and the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of other persons and the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation from a public register
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is made from a register which under Union or Member State law is intended to provide information to the public and is open to consultation either by the public in general or by any person who can demonstrate a legitimate interest, and only to the extent that the conditions laid down by Union or Member State law for consultation are fulfilled in the particular case
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is made from a register intended by Union or Member State law to provide information to the public and open to consultation by the public in general or by persons who can demonstrate a legitimate interest, and only to the extent that the legal conditions for consultation are fulfilled in the particular case.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer cannot be based on Article 45 or 46 (including binding corporate rules) and none of the derogations in paragraph 1(a)–(g) applies, the transfer is not repetitive, concerns only a limited number of data subjects, is necessary for purposes of compelling legitimate interests pursued by the controller that are not overridden by the interests or rights and freedoms of the data subject, and the controller has assessed all the circumstances surrounding the data transfer and on that basis provided suitable safeguards for the protection of personal data
units.exception: does not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers
units.proposition: The controller is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation under a compelling legitimate interests derogation only if the transfer cannot be based on Article 45 or 46 and none of the derogations in paragraph 1(a)–(g) applies, the transfer is not repetitive, concerns only a limited number of data subjects, is necessary for compelling legitimate interests not overridden by the data subject’s interests or rights and freedoms, and the controller has assessed all circumstances and provided suitable safeguards.

units.action: inform the supervisory authority of the transfer
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when the transfer is carried out under the compelling legitimate interests derogation described in paragraph 1 second subparagraph
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the supervisory authority of the transfer when relying on the compelling legitimate interests derogation of paragraph 1 second subparagraph.

units.action: inform the data subject of the transfer and the compelling legitimate interests pursued, in addition to the information required by Articles 13 and 14
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when the transfer is carried out under the compelling legitimate interests derogation described in paragraph 1 second subparagraph
units.proposition: The controller is obliged, in addition to providing the information referred to in Articles 13 and 14, to inform the data subject of the transfer and of the compelling legitimate interests pursued when relying on the compelling legitimate interests derogation of paragraph 1 second subparagraph.

units.action: make a transfer under point (g) that involves the entirety of the personal data or entire categories of personal data contained in the register
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when the transfer is pursuant to point (g) of paragraph 1
units.proposition: The controller or processor is prohibited from making a transfer pursuant to point (g) that involves the entirety of the personal data or entire categories of personal data contained in the register.

units.action: make a transfer under point (g) from a register intended for consultation by persons having a legitimate interest without a request from those persons or when they are not the recipients
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when the register is intended for consultation by persons having a legitimate interest
units.proposition: The controller or processor is prohibited from making a transfer under point (g) from a register intended for consultation by persons having a legitimate interest unless the transfer is made at the request of those persons or if they are to be the recipients.

units.action: set limits in law to the transfer of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: in the absence of an adequacy decision and for important reasons of public interest
units.proposition: The Union or Member State legislator has the power, in the absence of an adequacy decision and for important reasons of public interest, to set limits in law to the transfer of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation.

units.action: notify the Commission of provisions that set limits to transfers of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: national provisions limiting transfers of specific categories of personal data
units.condition: when such provisions are adopted under Union or Member State law for important reasons of public interest in the absence of an adequacy decision
units.proposition: Member States are obliged to notify the Commission of provisions that set limits to the transfer of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation when such provisions are adopted for important reasons of public interest in the absence of an adequacy decision.

units.action: document in the records referred to in Article 30 the assessment and the suitable safeguards referred to in paragraph 1 second subparagraph
units.scope: records of processing activities under Article 30
units.condition: when relying on the compelling legitimate interests derogation described in paragraph 1 second subparagraph
units.proposition: The controller or processor is obliged to document in the records referred to in Article 30 the assessment and the suitable safeguards referred to in paragraph 1 second subparagraph when relying on the compelling legitimate interests derogation.

units.action: issue an opinion on the matter submitted to it
units.scope: consistency mechanism matters
units.condition: a competent supervisory authority intends to adopt a decision that aims to determine standard data protection clauses under Article 46(2)(d) and Article 28(8), or to authorise contractual clauses under Article 46(3)(a), or to approve binding corporate rules under Article 47, or a request under paragraph 2 has been made
units.exception: where the Board has already issued an opinion on the same matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue an opinion on the matter submitted to it in the cases listed in paragraph 1(d)–(f) or upon a request under paragraph 2, unless it has already issued an opinion on the same matter.

units.action: adopt the opinion by simple majority of its members
units.scope: opinion under this Article
units.temporal: within eight weeks
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall adopt the opinion by simple majority of its members within eight weeks.

units.action: extend the opinion-adoption period by up to six weeks
units.scope: the eight-week period for adopting the opinion
units.condition: taking into account the complexity of the subject matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board may extend the eight-week period for adopting the opinion by up to six weeks, taking into account the complexity of the subject matter.

units.addressee: Member of the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: regarding the draft decision referred to in paragraph 1 circulated in accordance with paragraph 5
units.condition: the member has not objected within a reasonable period indicated by the Chair
units.consequence: the member is deemed to be in agreement with the draft decision
units.proposition: A member of the Board who has not objected within a reasonable period indicated by the Chair is deemed to be in agreement with the circulated draft decision.

units.action: communicate relevant information to the Board by electronic means using a standardised format
units.scope: including, as applicable, a summary of the facts, the draft decision, the grounds necessitating the measure, and the views of other supervisory authorities concerned
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities shall, without undue delay, communicate by electronic means to the Board, using a standardised format, any relevant information, including as applicable a summary of the facts, the draft decision, the grounds necessitating the measure, and the views of other supervisory authorities concerned.

units.action: communicate relevant information to the Board by electronic means using a standardised format
units.scope: including, as applicable, a summary of the facts, the draft decision, the grounds necessitating the measure, and the views of other supervisory authorities concerned
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The European Commission shall, without undue delay, communicate by electronic means to the Board, using a standardised format, any relevant information, including as applicable a summary of the facts, the draft decision, the grounds necessitating the measure, and the views of other supervisory authorities concerned.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: inform the members of the Board by electronic means of any relevant information communicated to the Board using a standardised format
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board shall, without undue delay, inform the members of the Board by electronic means of any relevant information communicated to the Board using a standardised format.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: inform the European Commission by electronic means of any relevant information communicated to the Board using a standardised format
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board shall, without undue delay, inform the European Commission by electronic means of any relevant information communicated to the Board using a standardised format.

units.addressee: Secretariat of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: provide translations of relevant information
units.condition: where necessary
units.proposition: The Secretariat of the Board shall provide translations of relevant information where necessary.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: inform the supervisory authority referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 by electronic means of the Board's opinion
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board shall, without undue delay, inform by electronic means the supervisory authority referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Board's opinion.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: inform the European Commission by electronic means of the Board's opinion
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board shall, without undue delay, inform by electronic means the European Commission of the Board's opinion.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: make the Board's opinion public
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board shall make the Board's opinion public without undue delay.

units.action: adopt its draft decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.condition: during the period for adoption of the opinion referred to in paragraph 3
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority shall not adopt its draft decision referred to in paragraph 1 during the period referred to in paragraph 3.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1
units.action: take utmost account of the opinion of the Board
units.proposition: The supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1 shall take utmost account of the opinion of the Board.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1
units.action: communicate to the Chair of the Board by electronic means whether it will maintain or amend its draft decision, using a standardised format
units.temporal: within two weeks after receiving the Board's opinion
units.proposition: The supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1 shall, within two weeks after receiving the Board's opinion, communicate to the Chair of the Board by electronic means, using a standardised format, whether it will maintain or amend its draft decision.

units.addressee: Supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1
units.action: communicate to the Chair of the Board by electronic means the amended draft decision, if any, using a standardised format
units.condition: if an amended draft decision exists
units.temporal: within two weeks after receiving the Board's opinion
units.proposition: The supervisory authority referred to in paragraph 1 shall, within two weeks after receiving the Board's opinion, communicate to the Chair of the Board by electronic means, using a standardised format, the amended draft decision, if any.

units.action: request that a matter be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion
units.scope: in particular where a competent supervisory authority does not comply with obligations for mutual assistance under Article 61 or for joint operations under Article 62
units.condition: the matter is of general application or produces effects in more than one Member State
units.proposition: Any supervisory authority may request that a matter of general application or producing effects in more than one Member State be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: request that a matter be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion
units.scope: in particular where a competent supervisory authority does not comply with obligations for mutual assistance under Article 61 or for joint operations under Article 62
units.condition: the matter is of general application or produces effects in more than one Member State
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board may request that a matter of general application or producing effects in more than one Member State be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion.

units.action: request that a matter be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion
units.scope: in particular where a competent supervisory authority does not comply with obligations for mutual assistance under Article 61 or for joint operations under Article 62
units.condition: the matter is of general application or produces effects in more than one Member State
units.proposition: The European Commission may request that a matter of general application or producing effects in more than one Member State be examined by the Board with a view to obtaining an opinion.

units.condition: the supervisory authority concerned informs the Chair of the Board within the period referred to in paragraph 7 that it does not intend to follow the Board's opinion, in whole or in part, and provides the relevant grounds
units.proposition: If the supervisory authority concerned informs the Chair within the period referred to in paragraph 7 that it does not intend to follow the Board's opinion, in whole or in part, providing the relevant grounds, Article 65(1) shall apply.

units.action: approve binding corporate rules in accordance with the consistency mechanism set out in Article 63
units.scope: approval of binding corporate rules
units.condition: provided that the binding corporate rules are legally binding and apply to and are enforced by every concerned member of the group, including their employees; expressly confer enforceable rights on data subjects regarding the processing of their personal data; and fulfil the requirements in Article 47(2)
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to approve binding corporate rules in accordance with the Article 63 consistency mechanism if the rules are legally binding, apply to and are enforced by every concerned group member including employees, confer enforceable rights on data subjects, and fulfil the requirements in Article 47(2).

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the structure and contact details of the group and of each of its members
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the structure and contact details of the group and of each of its members in those rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the data transfers or sets of transfers, including the categories of personal data, the type of processing and its purposes, the type of data subjects affected, and the identification of the third country or countries
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the relevant data transfers or sets of transfers, including categories of personal data, types and purposes of processing, types of data subjects affected, and the identification of the third country or countries.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the legally binding nature of the rules both internally and externally
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the legally binding nature of those rules both internally and externally.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the application of the general data protection principles, including purpose limitation, data minimisation, limited storage periods, data quality, data protection by design and by default, legal basis for processing, processing of special categories of personal data, measures to ensure data security, and requirements for onward transfers to bodies not bound by the rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify how the general data protection principles apply, including purpose limitation, data minimisation, storage limitation, data quality, data protection by design and by default, legal bases for processing, processing of special categories, data security measures, and requirements for onward transfers to bodies not bound by the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the rights of data subjects in regard to processing and the means to exercise those rights, including the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing including profiling under Article 22, the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority and before competent courts under Article 79, and to obtain redress and, where appropriate, compensation for a breach of the rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the rights of data subjects and the means to exercise them, including the Article 22 right against solely automated decisions, the right to lodge complaints with supervisory authorities and competent courts under Article 79, and to obtain redress and, where appropriate, compensation for a breach of the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the acceptance by the controller or processor established in a Member State of liability for any breaches of the rules by any concerned member not established in the Union
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules concerning liability
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify that a controller or processor established in a Member State accepts liability for any breaches of the rules by any concerned member not established in the Union.

units.addressee: controller or processor established in a Member State that has accepted liability under the binding corporate rules
units.action: obtain exemption from that liability, in whole or in part
units.scope: liability for breaches of the binding corporate rules by a non-EU group member
units.condition: only if it proves that the non-EU member is not responsible for the event giving rise to the damage
units.proposition: A controller or processor established in a Member State that has accepted liability under the binding corporate rules is permitted to obtain, in whole or in part, an exemption from that liability only if it proves that the non-EU member is not responsible for the event giving rise to the damage.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify how information on the binding corporate rules, in particular on the provisions in points (d), (e) and (f), is provided to data subjects in addition to Articles 13 and 14
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify how information on the rules, in particular the provisions referred to in points (d), (e) and (f), is provided to data subjects in addition to the information required under Articles 13 and 14.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the tasks of any designated data protection officer or other person or entity in charge of monitoring compliance with the rules within the group, as well as monitoring training and complaint-handling
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the tasks of any designated data protection officer or other person or entity responsible for monitoring compliance with the rules within the group, as well as monitoring training and complaint-handling.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the complaint procedures
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the complaint procedures.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify mechanisms within the group for ensuring the verification of compliance with the binding corporate rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify mechanisms within the group for ensuring the verification of compliance with the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: include data protection audits in the mechanisms for verifying compliance with the binding corporate rules
units.scope: mechanisms for verifying compliance with binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to include data protection audits in the mechanisms for verifying compliance with the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: include methods for ensuring corrective actions to protect the rights of the data subject in the mechanisms for verifying compliance with the binding corporate rules
units.scope: mechanisms for verifying compliance with binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to include methods for ensuring corrective actions to protect the rights of the data subject in the mechanisms for verifying compliance with the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify mechanisms for reporting changes to the binding corporate rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify mechanisms for reporting changes to the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify mechanisms for recording changes to the binding corporate rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify mechanisms for recording changes to the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify mechanisms for reporting changes to the binding corporate rules to the supervisory authority
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify mechanisms for reporting changes to the rules to the supervisory authority.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the cooperation mechanism with the supervisory authority to ensure compliance by any group member, including making available to the supervisory authority the results of verifications of the measures referred to in point (j)
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify the cooperation mechanism with the supervisory authority to ensure compliance by any group member, including making available to the supervisory authority the results of verifications of the measures referred to in point (j).

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify mechanisms for reporting to the competent supervisory authority any third-country legal requirements likely to have a substantial adverse effect on the guarantees provided by the binding corporate rules
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify mechanisms for reporting to the competent supervisory authority any third-country legal requirements likely to have a substantial adverse effect on the guarantees provided by the rules.

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify appropriate data protection training to personnel having permanent or regular access to personal data
units.scope: content of binding corporate rules
units.proposition: A controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules is obliged to specify appropriate data protection training for personnel having permanent or regular access to personal data.

units.action: specify the format and procedures for the exchange of information between controllers, processors and supervisory authorities for binding corporate rules
units.scope: exchange of information related to binding corporate rules
units.proposition: The European Commission has the power to specify the format and procedures for the exchange of information between controllers, processors and supervisory authorities for binding corporate rules.

units.action: adopt the implementing acts in accordance with the examination procedure set out in Article 93(2)
units.scope: implementing acts specifying the format and procedures for exchange of information on binding corporate rules
units.proposition: The European Commission is obliged to adopt the implementing acts under Article 47(3) in accordance with the examination procedure set out in Article 93(2).

units.action: take appropriate steps to develop international cooperation mechanisms to facilitate the effective enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: The European Commission is obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to develop international cooperation mechanisms to facilitate the effective enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data.

units.action: take appropriate steps to develop international cooperation mechanisms to facilitate the effective enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to develop international cooperation mechanisms to facilitate the effective enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data.

units.action: take appropriate steps to provide international mutual assistance in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data, including through notification, complaint referral, investigative assistance and information exchange
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.condition: subject to appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data and other fundamental rights and freedoms
units.proposition: The European Commission is obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to provide international mutual assistance in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data, including through notification, complaint referral, investigative assistance and information exchange, subject to appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data and other fundamental rights and freedoms.

units.action: take appropriate steps to provide international mutual assistance in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data, including through notification, complaint referral, investigative assistance and information exchange
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.condition: subject to appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data and other fundamental rights and freedoms
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to provide international mutual assistance in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data, including through notification, complaint referral, investigative assistance and information exchange, subject to appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data and other fundamental rights and freedoms.

units.action: take appropriate steps to engage relevant stakeholders in discussion and activities aimed at furthering international cooperation in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: The European Commission is obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to engage relevant stakeholders in discussion and activities aimed at furthering international cooperation in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data.

units.action: take appropriate steps to engage relevant stakeholders in discussion and activities aimed at furthering international cooperation in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to engage relevant stakeholders in discussion and activities aimed at furthering international cooperation in the enforcement of legislation for the protection of personal data.

units.action: take appropriate steps to promote the exchange and documentation of personal data protection legislation and practice, including on jurisdictional conflicts with third countries
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: The European Commission is obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to promote the exchange and documentation of personal data protection legislation and practice, including on jurisdictional conflicts with third countries.

units.action: take appropriate steps to promote the exchange and documentation of personal data protection legislation and practice, including on jurisdictional conflicts with third countries
units.scope: in relation to third countries and international organisations
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated, in relation to third countries and international organisations, to take appropriate steps to promote the exchange and documentation of personal data protection legislation and practice, including on jurisdictional conflicts with third countries.

units.action: provide for each member of their supervisory authorities to be appointed by means of a transparent procedure by one of the following authorities: the parliament, the government, the head of State, or an independent body entrusted with the appointment under Member State law
units.scope: members of the supervisory authorities of the Member State
units.proposition: Member States are obliged to ensure that each member of their supervisory authorities is appointed through a transparent procedure by the parliament, the government, the head of State, or an independent body entrusted with the appointment under Member State law.

units.addressee: each member of a supervisory authority
units.action: have the qualifications, experience and skills required to perform duties and exercise powers, in particular in the area of the protection of personal data
units.scope: members of a supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each member of a supervisory authority is obliged to have the qualifications, experience and skills required to perform the duties and exercise the powers, in particular in the area of the protection of personal data.

units.ru_label: End of duties on expiry, resignation or retirement
units.addressee: the competent authority under Member State law
units.action: end a member’s duties
units.scope: members of a supervisory authority
units.condition: in the event of expiry of the term of office, resignation or compulsory retirement, in accordance with the law of the Member State concerned
units.proposition: The competent authority under Member State law is obliged to end a member’s duties upon expiry of the term of office, resignation or compulsory retirement, in accordance with the law of the Member State concerned.

units.addressee: the competent dismissing authority under Member State law
units.action: dismiss a member
units.scope: members of a supervisory authority
units.exception: cases of serious misconduct or where the member no longer fulfils the conditions required for the performance of the duties
units.proposition: The competent dismissing authority under Member State law is prohibited from dismissing a member except in cases of serious misconduct or where the member no longer fulfils the conditions required for the performance of the duties.

units.action: provide for one or more independent public authorities to be responsible for monitoring the application of this Regulation
units.scope: independent public authorities responsible for monitoring application of the GDPR
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to provide for one or more independent public authorities that are responsible for monitoring the application of the GDPR.

units.action: contribute to the consistent application of this Regulation
units.scope: throughout the Union
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to contribute to the consistent application of the GDPR throughout the Union.

units.action: cooperate with each other and the Commission
units.scope: in accordance with Chapter VII
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to cooperate with the other supervisory authorities and the Commission in accordance with Chapter VII.
