units.action: designate the supervisory authority which is to represent those authorities in the Board
units.scope: representation of the Member State’s supervisory authorities in the Board
units.condition: Where more than one supervisory authority is established in a Member State
units.proposition: Where more than one supervisory authority is established in a Member State, that Member State is obliged to designate the supervisory authority that represents those authorities in the Board.

units.action: set out the mechanism to ensure compliance by the other authorities with the rules relating to the consistency mechanism
units.scope: rules relating to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63
units.condition: Where more than one supervisory authority is established in a Member State
units.proposition: Where more than one supervisory authority is established in a Member State, that Member State is obliged to set out a mechanism to ensure that the other authorities comply with the rules relating to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63.

units.action: notify to the Commission the provisions of its law adopted pursuant to this Chapter
units.scope: provisions of national law adopted pursuant to Chapter VI
units.temporal: by 25 May 2018
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to notify to the Commission, by 25 May 2018, the provisions of its law adopted pursuant to this Chapter.

units.action: notify to the Commission any subsequent amendment affecting those provisions
units.scope: amendments affecting the notified national provisions pursuant to this Chapter
units.condition: Following any subsequent amendment affecting those provisions
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to notify to the Commission, without delay, any subsequent amendment affecting those provisions.

units.action: act with complete independence
units.scope: when performing its tasks and exercising its powers
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to act with complete independence when performing its tasks and exercising its powers in accordance with this Regulation.

units.addressee: member or members of each supervisory authority
units.action: remain free from external influence
units.scope: in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers; external influence may be direct or indirect
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: The member or members of each supervisory authority are obliged to remain free from external influence, whether direct or indirect, in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers in accordance with this Regulation.

units.addressee: member or members of each supervisory authority
units.action: seek instructions from anybody
units.scope: in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: The member or members of each supervisory authority are prohibited from seeking instructions from anybody in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers in accordance with this Regulation.

units.addressee: member or members of each supervisory authority
units.action: take instructions from anybody
units.scope: in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: The member or members of each supervisory authority are prohibited from taking instructions from anybody in the performance of their tasks and the exercise of their powers in accordance with this Regulation.

units.addressee: member or members of each supervisory authority
units.action: perform any action incompatible with their duties
units.proposition: The member or members of each supervisory authority are prohibited from performing any action incompatible with their duties.

units.addressee: member or members of each supervisory authority
units.action: engage in any incompatible occupation, whether gainful or not
units.temporal: during their term of office
units.proposition: The member or members of each supervisory authority are prohibited, during their term of office, from engaging in any incompatible occupation, whether gainful or not.

units.action: ensure that each supervisory authority is provided with the human, technical and financial resources, premises and infrastructure necessary for effective performance
units.scope: for the effective performance of the supervisory authority’s tasks and exercise of its powers, including in the context of mutual assistance, cooperation and participation in the Board
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that each supervisory authority is provided with the human, technical and financial resources, premises and infrastructure necessary for the effective performance of its tasks and the exercise of its powers, including in the context of mutual assistance, cooperation and participation in the Board.

units.action: ensure that each supervisory authority chooses its own staff
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that each supervisory authority chooses its own staff.

units.action: ensure that each supervisory authority has its own staff
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that each supervisory authority has its own staff.

units.action: ensure that the staff of each supervisory authority is subject to the exclusive direction of the member or members of that supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that the staff of each supervisory authority is subject to the exclusive direction of the member or members of that supervisory authority.

units.action: ensure that each supervisory authority is subject to financial control that does not affect its independence
units.scope: financial control applied to supervisory authorities
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that each supervisory authority is subject to financial control that does not affect its independence.

units.action: ensure that each supervisory authority has separate, public annual budgets
units.proposition: Each Member State is obliged to ensure that each supervisory authority has separate, public annual budgets.

units.action: have the supervisory authority’s separate, public annual budgets be part of the overall state or national budget
units.scope: the supervisory authority’s separate, public annual budgets
units.condition: provided those budgets remain separate and public
units.proposition: Each Member State is permitted to have the supervisory authority’s separate, public annual budgets be part of the overall state or national budget, provided those budgets remain separate and public.

units.action: provide by law for the establishment of each supervisory authority
units.scope: each supervisory authority within the Member State
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for the establishment of each supervisory authority.

units.action: provide by law for the qualifications and eligibility conditions required to be appointed as member of each supervisory authority
units.scope: qualifications and eligibility conditions for appointment as member of each supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for the qualifications and eligibility conditions required to be appointed as member of each supervisory authority.

units.action: provide by law for the rules and procedures for appointing the member or members of each supervisory authority
units.scope: rules and procedures for appointment of the member or members of each supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for the rules and procedures for the appointment of the member or members of each supervisory authority.

units.action: provide by law for a duration of office for the member or members of each supervisory authority of no less than four years
units.scope: duration of the term of office of the member or members of each supervisory authority
units.exception: Except for the first appointment after 24 May 2016, part of which may be set for a shorter period where necessary to protect the independence of the supervisory authority by means of a staggered appointment procedure.
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for a duration of the term of the member or members of each supervisory authority of no less than four years, subject to the stated exception for the first appointment after 24 May 2016.

units.action: provide by law for a shorter period for part of the first appointment of members of the supervisory authority
units.scope: part of the first appointment of members of the supervisory authority
units.condition: where necessary to protect the independence of the supervisory authority by means of a staggered appointment procedure
units.temporal: for the first appointment after 24 May 2016
units.proposition: For the first appointment after 24 May 2016, each Member State may provide by law for a shorter period for part of the appointments where necessary to protect the independence of the supervisory authority by means of a staggered appointment procedure.

units.action: provide by law whether members of each supervisory authority are eligible for reappointment and, if so, for how many terms
units.scope: eligibility for reappointment and number of terms for members of each supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law whether the member or members of each supervisory authority are eligible for reappointment and, if so, for how many terms.

units.action: provide by law for the conditions governing the obligations of the members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.scope: conditions governing the obligations of the members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for the conditions governing the obligations of the member or members and staff of each supervisory authority.

units.action: provide by law for prohibitions on actions, occupations and benefits incompatible with the office of members and staff of each supervisory authority during and after the term of office
units.scope: prohibitions on incompatible actions, occupations and benefits for members and staff during and after their term of office
units.temporal: during and after the term of office
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for prohibitions on actions, occupations and benefits incompatible with the office of the member or members and staff of each supervisory authority during and after the term of office.

units.action: provide by law for rules governing the cessation of employment of members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.scope: rules governing the cessation of employment of members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.proposition: Each Member State shall provide by law for rules governing the cessation of employment of the member or members and staff of each supervisory authority.

units.addressee: Members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.action: maintain professional secrecy regarding confidential information obtained in the course of performing their tasks or exercising their powers
units.scope: any confidential information that has come to their knowledge in the course of the performance of their tasks or the exercise of their powers; in accordance with Union or Member State law
units.temporal: both during and after their term of office
units.proposition: Members and staff of each supervisory authority shall, in accordance with Union or Member State law, maintain professional secrecy regarding any confidential information obtained in the course of performing their tasks or exercising their powers, both during and after their term of office.

units.addressee: Members and staff of each supervisory authority
units.action: maintain professional secrecy regarding reports by natural persons of infringements of the Regulation
units.scope: reporting by natural persons of infringements of the GDPR
units.temporal: during their term of office
units.proposition: During their term of office, members and staff of each supervisory authority shall maintain professional secrecy regarding reports by natural persons of infringements of this Regulation.

units.action: be competent for the performance of the tasks assigned to it
units.scope: on the territory of its own Member State
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to perform the tasks assigned to it, in accordance with this Regulation, on the territory of its own Member State.

units.action: be competent for the exercise of the powers conferred on it
units.scope: on the territory of its own Member State
units.condition: in accordance with this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to exercise the powers conferred on it, in accordance with this Regulation, on the territory of its own Member State.

units.action: draw up an annual report on its activities
units.temporal: annually
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to draw up an annual report on its activities.

units.ru_label: Optional inclusion of infringement and measures list
units.action: include in the annual report a list of types of infringement notified and types of measures taken in accordance with Article 58(2)
units.scope: content of the annual activity report
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is permitted to include in its annual report a list of types of infringement notified and types of measures taken in accordance with Article 58(2).

units.action: transmit the annual activity report to designated recipients
units.scope: the national parliament, the government, and other authorities as designated by Member State law
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to transmit its annual activity report to the national parliament, the government and other authorities as designated by Member State law.

units.ru_label: Make report available to public, Commission and Board
units.action: make the annual activity report available
units.scope: the public, the Commission and the Board
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obliged to make its annual activity report available to the public, to the Commission and to the Board.

units.addressee: supervisory authority of the main or single establishment of the controller or processor
units.action: act as lead supervisory authority
units.scope: for cross-border processing carried out by the relevant controller or processor
units.condition: in accordance with the procedure provided in Article 60
units.exception: without prejudice to Article 55
units.proposition: The supervisory authority of the main or single establishment of the controller or processor has the power to act as the lead supervisory authority for cross-border processing by that controller or processor, subject to the procedure in Article 60 and without prejudice to Article 55.

units.action: handle a complaint lodged with it
units.scope: a case under this Regulation
units.condition: the subject matter relates only to an establishment in its Member State or substantially affects data subjects only in its Member State
units.exception: by derogation from paragraph 1
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to handle a complaint lodged with it if the subject matter relates only to an establishment in its Member State or substantially affects data subjects only in its Member State, by derogation from paragraph 1.

units.action: handle a possible infringement of this Regulation
units.scope: a case under this Regulation
units.condition: the subject matter relates only to an establishment in its Member State or substantially affects data subjects only in its Member State
units.exception: by derogation from paragraph 1
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to handle a possible infringement of this Regulation if the subject matter relates only to an establishment in its Member State or substantially affects data subjects only in its Member State, by derogation from paragraph 1.

units.addressee: supervisory authority handling a case under paragraph 2
units.action: inform the lead supervisory authority about the matter
units.scope: the case referred to in paragraph 2
units.condition: in the cases referred to in paragraph 2
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: A supervisory authority handling a case under paragraph 2 must inform the lead supervisory authority about the matter without delay.

units.ru_label: Lead SA decide within three weeks
units.action: decide whether or not it will handle the case in accordance with Article 60
units.scope: the case about which it was informed by another supervisory authority
units.condition: after being informed by another supervisory authority under paragraph 3
units.temporal: within three weeks after being informed
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority must, within three weeks after being informed under paragraph 3, decide whether or not it will handle the case in accordance with the procedure provided in Article 60.

units.action: take into account whether there is an establishment of the controller or processor in the Member State of the informing supervisory authority
units.scope: the decision whether to handle the case
units.condition: when deciding under paragraph 3 whether to handle the case
units.proposition: When deciding under paragraph 3 whether to handle the case, the lead supervisory authority must take into account whether there is an establishment of the controller or processor in the Member State of the supervisory authority that informed it.

units.action: apply the procedure provided in Article 60
units.scope: handling of the case
units.condition: where the lead supervisory authority decides to handle the case
units.proposition: Where the lead supervisory authority decides to handle the case, it must apply the procedure provided in Article 60.

units.ru_label: Informing SA may submit draft decision
units.addressee: supervisory authority which informed the lead supervisory authority
units.action: submit to the lead supervisory authority a draft for a decision
units.scope: the case handled by the lead supervisory authority
units.condition: where the lead supervisory authority decides to handle the case
units.proposition: Where the lead supervisory authority decides to handle the case, the supervisory authority that informed it may submit to the lead supervisory authority a draft for a decision.

units.ru_label: Lead SA take utmost account of draft
units.action: take utmost account of the draft submitted by the informing supervisory authority when preparing the draft decision referred to in Article 60(3)
units.scope: preparation of the draft decision under Article 60(3)
units.condition: when preparing the draft decision under Article 60(3) and a draft has been submitted by the informing supervisory authority
units.proposition: When preparing the draft decision referred to in Article 60(3), the lead supervisory authority must take utmost account of any draft submitted by the supervisory authority that informed it.

units.ru_label: Informing SA handles if lead declines
units.addressee: supervisory authority which informed the lead supervisory authority
units.action: handle the case according to Articles 61 and 62
units.scope: the case that the lead supervisory authority decided not to handle
units.condition: where the lead supervisory authority decides not to handle the case
units.proposition: Where the lead supervisory authority decides not to handle the case, the supervisory authority that informed it must handle the case according to Articles 61 and 62.

units.action: act as the sole interlocutor of the controller or processor
units.scope: for cross-border processing carried out by that controller or processor
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority has the power to act as the sole interlocutor of the controller or processor for cross-border processing carried out by that controller or processor.

units.action: order the controller, the processor, and, where applicable, their representative to provide any information the supervisory authority requires for the performance of its tasks
units.scope: investigative powers
units.condition: Where applicable regarding the representative; the information is required for the performance of the supervisory authority's tasks
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the controller, the processor, and, where applicable, their representative to provide any information the supervisory authority requires for the performance of its tasks.

units.action: carry out investigations in the form of data protection audits
units.scope: investigative powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to carry out investigations in the form of data protection audits.

units.action: carry out a review on certifications
units.scope: investigative powers; certifications issued pursuant to Article 42(7)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to carry out a review on certifications issued pursuant to Article 42(7).

units.action: notify the controller or the processor of an alleged infringement of this Regulation
units.scope: investigative powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to notify the controller or the processor of an alleged infringement of this Regulation.

units.action: obtain from the controller and the processor access to all personal data
units.scope: investigative powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to obtain from the controller and the processor access to all personal data.

units.action: obtain from the controller and the processor access to all information necessary for the performance of its tasks
units.scope: investigative powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to obtain from the controller and the processor access to all information necessary for the performance of its tasks.

units.action: obtain access to any premises of the controller and the processor, including any data processing equipment and means
units.scope: investigative powers
units.condition: In accordance with Union or Member State procedural law
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to obtain access to any premises of the controller and the processor, including any data processing equipment and means, in accordance with Union or Member State procedural law.

units.action: issue warnings to a controller or processor
units.scope: corrective powers; concerning intended processing operations likely to infringe provisions of this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to issue warnings to a controller or processor that intended processing operations are likely to infringe provisions of this Regulation.

units.action: issue reprimands to a controller or a processor
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Where processing operations have infringed provisions of this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to issue reprimands to a controller or a processor where processing operations have infringed provisions of this Regulation.

units.action: order the controller or the processor to comply with the data subject's requests to exercise his or her rights pursuant to this Regulation
units.scope: corrective powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the controller or the processor to comply with the data subject's requests to exercise his or her rights pursuant to this Regulation.

units.action: order the controller or processor to bring processing operations into compliance with the provisions of this Regulation, including in a specified manner
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Where appropriate
units.temporal: Within a specified period
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power, where appropriate, to order the controller or processor to bring processing operations into compliance with the provisions of this Regulation, including in a specified manner and within a specified period.

units.action: order the controller to communicate a personal data breach to the data subject
units.scope: corrective powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the controller to communicate a personal data breach to the data subject.

units.action: impose a temporary or definitive limitation, including a ban, on processing
units.scope: corrective powers
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to impose a temporary or definitive limitation, including a ban, on processing.

units.action: order the rectification of personal data
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the rectification of personal data pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18.

units.action: order the erasure of personal data
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the erasure of personal data pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18.

units.action: order the restriction of processing
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the restriction of processing pursuant to Articles 16, 17 and 18.

units.action: order the notification of such actions to recipients to whom the personal data have been disclosed
units.scope: corrective powers
units.condition: Where rectification, erasure or restriction of processing has been ordered
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the notification of rectification, erasure, or restriction of processing to recipients to whom the personal data have been disclosed.

units.action: monitor the application of this Regulation
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation, monitor the application of this Regulation.

units.action: enforce the application of this Regulation
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation, enforce the application of this Regulation.

units.action: promote public awareness and understanding of the risks, rules, safeguards and rights in relation to processing
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation, promote public awareness and understanding of the risks, rules, safeguards and rights in relation to processing.

units.action: give specific attention to activities addressed specifically to children in its public awareness and understanding activities
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation, give specific attention to activities addressed specifically to children in its public awareness and understanding activities.

units.action: advise the national parliament, the government, and other institutions and bodies on legislative and administrative measures relating to the protection of natural persons' rights and freedoms with regard to processing
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: in accordance with Member State law and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and in accordance with Member State law, advise the national parliament, the government, and other institutions and bodies on legislative and administrative measures relating to the protection of natural persons' rights and freedoms with regard to processing.

units.action: promote the awareness of controllers and processors of their obligations under this Regulation
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation, promote the awareness of controllers and processors of their obligations under this Regulation.

units.action: provide information to any data subject concerning the exercise of their rights under this Regulation
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: upon request and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, upon request, provide information to any data subject concerning the exercise of their rights under this Regulation.

units.action: cooperate with supervisory authorities in other Member States to provide information to data subjects concerning the exercise of their rights
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: if appropriate and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, if appropriate, cooperate with supervisory authorities in other Member States to provide information to data subjects concerning the exercise of their rights.

units.action: handle complaints
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: when lodged by a data subject or by a body, organisation or association in accordance with Article 80, and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, handle complaints lodged by a data subject or by a body, organisation or association in accordance with Article 80.

units.action: investigate the subject matter of the complaint
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: to the extent appropriate and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, investigate the subject matter of the complaint to the extent appropriate.

units.action: inform the complainant of the progress and the outcome of the investigation
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: in particular if further investigation or coordination with another supervisory authority is necessary, and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.temporal: within a reasonable period
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, inform the complainant of the progress and the outcome of the investigation within a reasonable period, in particular if further investigation or coordination with another supervisory authority is necessary.

units.action: cooperate with other supervisory authorities
units.scope: on its territory and with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, cooperate with other supervisory authorities with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation.

units.action: share information with other supervisory authorities
units.scope: on its territory and with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, share information with other supervisory authorities with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation.

units.action: provide mutual assistance to other supervisory authorities
units.scope: on its territory and with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, provide mutual assistance to other supervisory authorities with a view to ensuring the consistency of application and enforcement of this Regulation.

units.action: conduct investigations on the application of this Regulation
units.scope: on its territory, including on the basis of information received from another supervisory authority or other public authority
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, conduct investigations on the application of this Regulation, including on the basis of information received from another supervisory authority or other public authority.

units.action: monitor relevant developments
units.scope: on its territory, in particular the development of information and communication technologies and commercial practices
units.condition: insofar as they have an impact on the protection of personal data and without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, monitor relevant developments, in particular the development of information and communication technologies and commercial practices, insofar as they have an impact on the protection of personal data.

units.action: adopt standard contractual clauses referred to in Article 28(8) and in point (d) of Article 46(2)
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, adopt standard contractual clauses referred to in Article 28(8) and in point (d) of Article 46(2).

units.action: establish and maintain a list in relation to the requirement for data protection impact assessment
units.scope: on its territory
units.condition: without prejudice to other tasks set out under this Regulation
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, on its territory, establish and maintain a list in relation to the requirement for data protection impact assessment.

units.action: cooperate with the other supervisory authorities concerned to reach consensus
units.scope: in accordance with Article 60
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall cooperate with the other supervisory authorities concerned in accordance with Article 60 in an endeavour to reach consensus.

units.action: exchange all relevant information with the other supervisory authorities concerned
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall exchange all relevant information with the other supervisory authorities concerned.

units.ru_label: Other SAs exchange relevant information with LSA
units.action: exchange all relevant information with the lead supervisory authority
units.proposition: The supervisory authorities concerned shall exchange all relevant information with the lead supervisory authority.

units.ru_label: LSA power to request mutual assistance
units.action: request other supervisory authorities concerned to provide mutual assistance
units.scope: pursuant to Article 61
units.temporal: at any time
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority may at any time request other supervisory authorities concerned to provide mutual assistance pursuant to Article 61.

units.ru_label: LSA power to conduct joint operations
units.action: conduct joint operations
units.scope: pursuant to Article 62, in particular for carrying out investigations or for monitoring implementation of a measure concerning a controller or processor established in another Member State
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority may conduct joint operations pursuant to Article 62, in particular for carrying out investigations or for monitoring the implementation of a measure concerning a controller or processor established in another Member State.

units.ru_label: LSA communicate relevant information without delay
units.action: communicate the relevant information on the matter to the other supervisory authorities concerned
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall, without delay, communicate the relevant information on the matter to the other supervisory authorities concerned.

units.ru_label: LSA submit draft decision without delay
units.action: submit a draft decision to the other supervisory authorities concerned for their opinion
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall without delay submit a draft decision to the other supervisory authorities concerned for their opinion.

units.ru_label: LSA take due account of views
units.action: take due account of the views of the other supervisory authorities concerned
units.scope: on the draft decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall take due account of the views of the other supervisory authorities concerned on the draft decision.

units.ru_label: LSA refer dispute to consistency mechanism
units.action: submit the matter to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63
units.condition: An other supervisory authority concerned expresses a relevant and reasoned objection to the draft decision within four weeks after being consulted under paragraph 3, and the lead supervisory authority does not follow the objection or considers it not relevant or reasoned.
units.proposition: If an other supervisory authority concerned expresses a relevant and reasoned objection within four weeks after the consultation under paragraph 3 and the lead supervisory authority does not follow it or deems it not relevant or reasoned, the lead supervisory authority shall submit the matter to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63.

units.ru_label: LSA submit revised draft when following objection
units.action: submit a revised draft decision to the other supervisory authorities concerned for their opinion
units.condition: The lead supervisory authority intends to follow the relevant and reasoned objection made.
units.proposition: Where the lead supervisory authority intends to follow the relevant and reasoned objection made, it shall submit a revised draft decision to the other supervisory authorities concerned for their opinion.

units.ru_label: LSA apply para4 procedure to revised draft within 2 weeks
units.action: subject the revised draft decision to the paragraph 4 procedure
units.condition: A revised draft decision has been submitted under paragraph 5.
units.temporal: within a period of two weeks
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall subject the revised draft decision to the paragraph 4 procedure within a period of two weeks.

units.ru_label: LSA bound by draft decision absent objections
units.action: be bound by the draft decision submitted by the lead supervisory authority
units.condition: None of the other supervisory authorities concerned has objected to the draft decision within the period referred to in paragraphs 4 and 5.
units.proposition: Where none of the other supervisory authorities concerned has objected within the applicable period, the lead supervisory authority shall be bound by the draft decision.

units.ru_label: Other SAs bound by draft decision absent objections
units.action: be bound by the draft decision submitted by the lead supervisory authority
units.condition: None of the other supervisory authorities concerned has objected to the draft decision within the period referred to in paragraphs 4 and 5.
units.proposition: Where none of the supervisory authorities concerned has objected within the applicable period, the supervisory authorities concerned shall be bound by the draft decision.

units.action: adopt the decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall adopt the decision.

units.ru_label: LSA notify decision to controller or processor establishment
units.action: notify the decision to the main establishment or single establishment of the controller or processor
units.scope: as applicable
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall notify the decision to the main establishment or single establishment of the controller or processor, as the case may be.

units.ru_label: LSA inform other SAs and Board with summary
units.action: inform the other supervisory authorities concerned and the Board of the decision, including a summary of the relevant facts and grounds
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall inform the other supervisory authorities concerned and the Board of the decision, including a summary of the relevant facts and grounds.

units.ru_label: SA receiving complaint inform complainant of decision
units.addressee: supervisory authority with which a complaint has been lodged
units.action: inform the complainant of the decision
units.proposition: The supervisory authority with which a complaint has been lodged shall inform the complainant of the decision.

units.ru_label: Complaint SA adopt decision on dismissal or rejection
units.addressee: supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged
units.action: adopt the decision on the complaint
units.scope: where the complaint is dismissed or rejected
units.condition: A complaint is dismissed or rejected.
units.exception: By derogation from paragraph 7
units.proposition: By derogation from paragraph 7, where a complaint is dismissed or rejected, the supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged shall adopt the decision.

units.ru_label: Complaint SA notify complainant of dismissal/rejection decision
units.addressee: supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged
units.action: notify the dismissal or rejection decision to the complainant
units.condition: A complaint is dismissed or rejected.
units.exception: By derogation from paragraph 7
units.proposition: By derogation from paragraph 7, where a complaint is dismissed or rejected, the supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged shall notify the decision to the complainant.

units.ru_label: Complaint SA inform controller of dismissal/rejection decision
units.addressee: supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged
units.action: inform the controller of the dismissal or rejection decision
units.condition: A complaint is dismissed or rejected.
units.exception: By derogation from paragraph 7
units.proposition: By derogation from paragraph 7, where a complaint is dismissed or rejected, the supervisory authority with which the complaint was lodged shall inform the controller of the decision.

units.ru_label: LSA adopt decision for action part
units.action: adopt the decision for the part concerning actions in relation to the controller
units.condition: The lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts of that complaint.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts, the lead supervisory authority shall adopt the decision for the part concerning actions in relation to the controller.

units.ru_label: LSA notify action-part decision to controller/processor establishment
units.action: notify the action-part decision to the main or single establishment of the controller or processor
units.scope: on the territory of its Member State
units.condition: The authorities agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to split the complaint, the lead supervisory authority shall notify the decision for the action part to the main establishment or single establishment of the controller or processor on the territory of its Member State.

units.ru_label: LSA inform complainant of action-part decision
units.action: inform the complainant of the action-part decision
units.condition: The authorities agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to split the complaint, the lead supervisory authority shall inform the complainant of the decision for the action part.

units.action: adopt the decision for the part concerning dismissal or rejection of the complaint
units.condition: The lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts of that complaint.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to split the complaint, the supervisory authority of the complainant shall adopt the decision for the part concerning dismissal or rejection of the complaint.

units.ru_label: Complainant’s SA notify complainant of dismissal/rejection-part decision
units.action: notify the dismissal or rejection-part decision to the complainant
units.condition: The authorities agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to split the complaint, the supervisory authority of the complainant shall notify that decision to the complainant.

units.ru_label: Complainant’s SA inform controller or processor of dismissal/rejection-part decision
units.action: inform the controller or processor of the dismissal or rejection-part decision
units.condition: The authorities agree to dismiss or reject parts of a complaint and to act on other parts.
units.proposition: Where the authorities agree to split the complaint, the supervisory authority of the complainant shall inform the controller or processor of that decision.

units.ru_label: Controller/processor ensure compliance Union-wide after notification
units.action: take the necessary measures to ensure compliance with the decision as regards processing activities in the context of all its establishments in the Union
units.condition: After being notified of the decision of the lead supervisory authority pursuant to paragraphs 7 and 9.
units.proposition: After being notified of the decision of the lead supervisory authority pursuant to paragraphs 7 and 9, the controller or processor shall take the necessary measures to ensure compliance with the decision as regards processing activities in the context of all its establishments in the Union.

units.ru_label: Controller/processor notify compliance measures to LSA
units.action: notify the measures taken for complying with the decision to the lead supervisory authority
units.condition: After taking the necessary measures to ensure compliance with the decision.
units.proposition: The controller or processor shall notify the measures taken for complying with the decision to the lead supervisory authority.

units.ru_label: LSA inform other SAs of compliance measures
units.action: inform the other supervisory authorities concerned of the measures notified by the controller or processor
units.condition: Upon receiving notification of the measures taken by the controller or processor.
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall inform the other supervisory authorities concerned of the measures notified by the controller or processor.

units.ru_label: Concerned SA apply urgency procedure in exceptional circumstances
units.action: apply the urgency procedure referred to in Article 66
units.condition: In exceptional circumstances, it has reasons to consider that there is an urgent need to act in order to protect the interests of data subjects.
units.proposition: Where, in exceptional circumstances, a supervisory authority concerned has reasons to consider that there is an urgent need to act to protect the interests of data subjects, it shall apply the urgency procedure referred to in Article 66.

units.ru_label: LSA supply info electronically in standardised format
units.action: supply the information required under Article 60 to the other supervisory authorities concerned by electronic means using a standardised format
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority shall supply the information required under Article 60 to the other supervisory authorities concerned by electronic means, using a standardised format.

units.ru_label: Other SAs supply info electronically in standardised format
units.action: supply the information required under Article 60 to the lead supervisory authority by electronic means using a standardised format
units.proposition: The other supervisory authorities concerned shall supply the information required under Article 60 to the lead supervisory authority by electronic means, using a standardised format.

units.action: cooperate with each other through the consistency mechanism as set out in this Section
units.scope: to contribute to the consistent application of this Regulation throughout the Union
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obliged to cooperate with each other through the consistency mechanism as set out in this Section to contribute to the consistent application of this Regulation throughout the Union.

units.action: cooperate with the Commission through the consistency mechanism as set out in this Section
units.scope: to contribute to the consistent application of this Regulation throughout the Union
units.condition: where relevant
units.proposition: Where relevant, supervisory authorities are obliged to cooperate with the Commission through the consistency mechanism as set out in this Section to contribute to the consistent application of this Regulation throughout the Union.

units.action: issue an opinion
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority intends to adopt a list of the processing operations subject to the requirement for a data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35(4)
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to issue an opinion when a competent supervisory authority intends to adopt a list of processing operations subject to a data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35(4).

units.action: issue an opinion
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority's draft decision concerns, pursuant to Article 40(7), whether a draft code of conduct or an amendment or extension to a code of conduct complies with this Regulation
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to issue an opinion when a competent supervisory authority's draft decision concerns, pursuant to Article 40(7), whether a draft code of conduct or an amendment or extension to a code of conduct complies with this Regulation.

units.action: issue an opinion
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority intends to approve the criteria for accreditation of a body pursuant to Article 41(3) or a certification body pursuant to
units.proposition: The Board is obliged to issue an opinion when a competent supervisory authority intends to approve the criteria for accreditation of a body pursuant to Article 41(3) or a certification body pursuant to.

units.action: communicate the draft decision to the Board
units.condition: when it aims to adopt a list of the processing operations subject to the requirement for a data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35(4)
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to communicate the draft decision to the Board when it aims to adopt a list of processing operations subject to a data protection impact assessment pursuant to Article 35(4).

units.action: communicate the draft decision to the Board
units.condition: when it concerns a matter pursuant to Article 40(7) whether a draft code of conduct or an amendment or extension to a code of conduct complies with this Regulation
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to communicate the draft decision to the Board when it concerns, pursuant to Article 40(7), whether a draft code of conduct or an amendment or extension to a code of conduct complies with this Regulation.

units.action: communicate the draft decision to the Board
units.condition: when it aims to approve the criteria for accreditation of a body pursuant to Article 41(3) or a certification body pursuant to
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to communicate the draft decision to the Board when it aims to approve the criteria for accreditation of a body pursuant to Article 41(3) or a certification body pursuant to.

units.action: promote cooperation and the effective bilateral and multilateral exchange of information and best practices
units.scope: between the supervisory authorities
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall promote cooperation and the effective bilateral and multilateral exchange of information and best practices between the supervisory authorities.

units.action: promote common training programmes
units.scope: for supervisory authorities
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall promote common training programmes for supervisory authorities.

units.action: facilitate personnel exchanges
units.scope: between supervisory authorities
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall facilitate personnel exchanges between supervisory authorities.

units.action: facilitate personnel exchanges
units.scope: with the supervisory authorities of third countries or with international organisations
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Where appropriate, the European Data Protection Board shall facilitate personnel exchanges with the supervisory authorities of third countries or with international organisations.

units.action: promote the exchange of knowledge and documentation on data protection legislation and practice
units.scope: with data protection supervisory authorities worldwide
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall promote the exchange of knowledge and documentation on data protection legislation and practice with data protection supervisory authorities worldwide.

units.action: issue opinions on codes of conduct
units.scope: codes of conduct drawn up at Union level pursuant to Article 40(9)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue opinions on codes of conduct drawn up at Union level pursuant to Article 40(9).

units.action: maintain a publicly accessible electronic register
units.scope: decisions taken by supervisory authorities and courts on issues handled in the consistency mechanism
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall maintain a publicly accessible electronic register of decisions taken by supervisory authorities and courts on issues handled in the consistency mechanism.

units.action: indicate a time limit
units.scope: for the requested advice from the European Data Protection Board
units.condition: when requesting advice from the European Data Protection Board; taking into account the urgency of the matter
units.proposition: The European Commission may, when requesting advice from the European Data Protection Board, indicate a time limit, taking into account the urgency of the matter.

units.action: forward its opinions, guidelines, recommendations, and best practices
units.scope: to the European Commission and to the committee referred to in Article 93
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall forward its opinions, guidelines, recommendations, and best practices to the European Commission and to the committee referred to in Article 93.

units.action: make public its opinions, guidelines, recommendations, and best practices
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall make its opinions, guidelines, recommendations, and best practices public.

units.action: consult interested parties
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Where appropriate, the European Data Protection Board shall consult interested parties.

units.action: give interested parties the opportunity to comment
units.scope: interested parties consulted by the Board
units.condition: when consulting interested parties
units.temporal: within a reasonable period
units.proposition: When consulting interested parties, the European Data Protection Board shall give them the opportunity to comment within a reasonable period.

units.action: make the results of the consultation procedure publicly available
units.exception: without prejudice to Article 76
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall make the results of the consultation procedure publicly available, without prejudice to Article 76.

units.action: provide each other with relevant information and mutual assistance
units.scope: to implement and apply the GDPR in a consistent manner
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated to provide each other with relevant information and mutual assistance to implement and apply the GDPR in a consistent manner.

units.action: put in place measures for effective cooperation with one another
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated to put in place measures for effective cooperation with one another.

units.action: ensure that mutual assistance covers information requests and supervisory measures, including requests to carry out prior authorisations and consultations, inspections and investigations
units.scope: scope of mutual assistance between supervisory authorities
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are obligated to ensure that mutual assistance covers information requests and supervisory measures, including requests to carry out prior authorisations and consultations, inspections and investigations.

units.action: take all appropriate measures required to reply to a request of another supervisory authority
units.condition: upon receiving a request from another supervisory authority
units.temporal: without undue delay and no later than one month after receiving the request
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority is obligated to take all appropriate measures required to reply to a request of another supervisory authority without undue delay and no later than one month after receiving the request.

units.action: transmit relevant information on the conduct of an investigation as part of the measures to reply to a request
units.condition: when taking measures to reply to a request from another supervisory authority
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are permitted to transmit relevant information on the conduct of an investigation as part of the measures to reply to a request from another supervisory authority.

units.action: include all necessary information, including the purpose of and reasons for the request, in a request for assistance
units.scope: content of a request for mutual assistance
units.condition: when issuing a request for assistance to another supervisory authority
units.proposition: A requesting supervisory authority is obligated to include all necessary information, including the purpose of and reasons for the request, in a request for assistance.

units.action: use exchanged information for purposes other than the purpose for which it was requested
units.scope: information exchanged under mutual assistance
units.condition: when using information exchanged under this Article
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are prohibited from using information exchanged under this Article for purposes other than the purpose for which it was requested.

units.ru_label: No refusal to comply with request
units.action: refuse to comply with a request for assistance
units.condition: upon receiving a request for assistance from another supervisory authority
units.exception: if the authority is not competent for the subject-matter or the requested measures, or if compliance would infringe the GDPR or applicable Union or Member State law
units.proposition: A requested supervisory authority is prohibited from refusing to comply with a request for assistance unless it is not competent for the subject-matter or the requested measures, or compliance would infringe the GDPR or applicable Union or Member State law.

units.action: inform the requesting supervisory authority of the results or the progress of the measures taken to respond to the request
units.scope: measures taken to respond to the request for assistance
units.condition: after taking measures to respond to the request
units.proposition: A requested supervisory authority is obligated to inform the requesting supervisory authority of the results or the progress of the measures taken to respond to the request.

units.action: provide reasons for any refusal to comply with a request
units.condition: when refusing to comply with a request pursuant to Article 61(4)
units.proposition: A requested supervisory authority is obligated to provide reasons for any refusal to comply with a request pursuant to Article 61(4).

units.ru_label: Supply info electronically in standard format
units.action: supply the information requested by other supervisory authorities by electronic means using a standardised format
units.scope: mode and format of supplying requested information
units.condition: as a rule
units.proposition: Requested supervisory authorities are obligated, as a rule, to supply the information requested by other supervisory authorities by electronic means using a standardised format.

units.ru_label: No fees for mutual assistance actions
units.action: charge a fee for any action taken pursuant to a request for mutual assistance
units.scope: actions taken pursuant to a request for mutual assistance
units.proposition: Requested supervisory authorities are prohibited from charging a fee for any action taken pursuant to a request for mutual assistance.

units.action: agree on rules to indemnify each other for specific expenditure arising from the provision of mutual assistance
units.scope: specific expenditure arising from the provision of mutual assistance
units.condition: in exceptional circumstances
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are permitted, in exceptional circumstances, to agree on rules to indemnify each other for specific expenditure arising from the provision of mutual assistance.

units.ru_label: Requesting SA may adopt provisional measure
units.action: adopt a provisional measure
units.scope: on the territory of its Member State in accordance with Article 55(1)
units.condition: if the requested supervisory authority does not provide the information referred to in Article 61(5) within one month of receiving the request
units.proposition: A requesting supervisory authority has the power to adopt a provisional measure on the territory of its Member State in accordance with Article 55(1) if the requested supervisory authority does not provide the information referred to in Article 61(5) within one month of receiving the request.

units.action: adopt an urgent binding decision pursuant to Article 66(2)
units.condition: where a requesting supervisory authority adopts a provisional measure because the requested authority did not provide the information referred to in Article 61(5) within one month
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obligated to adopt an urgent binding decision pursuant to Article 66(2) where a requesting supervisory authority adopts a provisional measure because the requested authority did not provide the information referred to in Article 61(5) within one month.

units.ru_label: Commission power to specify formats and procedures
units.action: specify by implementing acts the format and procedures for mutual assistance and the arrangements for the exchange of information by electronic means, including the standardised format referred to in Article 61(6)
units.scope: between supervisory authorities and between supervisory authorities and the Board
units.proposition: The European Commission has the power, by means of implementing acts, to specify the format and procedures for mutual assistance and the arrangements for the exchange of information by electronic means, including the standardised format referred to in Article 61(6), between supervisory authorities and between supervisory authorities and the Board.

units.action: adopt the implementing acts referred to in Article 61(9) in accordance with the examination procedure in Article 93(2)
units.scope: implementing acts specifying formats, procedures, and arrangements for mutual assistance and information exchange
units.condition: when adopting implementing acts under Article 61(9)
units.proposition: The European Commission is obligated to adopt the implementing acts referred to in Article 61(9) in accordance with the examination procedure in Article 93(2).

units.action: adopt provisional measures intended to produce legal effects with a specified period of validity
units.scope: on its own territory
units.condition: in exceptional circumstances where it considers there is an urgent need to act to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects
units.exception: by way of derogation from the consistency mechanism in Articles 63, 64 and 65 and the procedure in Article 60
units.temporal: immediately
units.proposition: A supervisory authority concerned may, in exceptional circumstances where it considers an urgent need to act to protect data subjects’ rights and freedoms, immediately adopt provisional measures producing legal effects on its own territory, by way of derogation from Articles 60 and 63–65, with a specified period of validity.

units.addressee: supervisory authority that adopted provisional measures under Article 66(1)
units.action: communicate the adopted provisional measures and the reasons for adopting them to the other supervisory authorities concerned, the Board and the Commission
units.scope: measures adopted under Article 66(1)
units.condition: after adopting provisional measures under paragraph 1
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: The supervisory authority that adopted provisional measures under Article 66(1) shall, without delay, communicate those measures and the reasons for adopting them to the other supervisory authorities concerned, to the Board and to the Commission.

units.action: specify a period of validity for the provisional measures it adopts under Article 66(1)
units.scope: provisional measures under Article 66(1)
units.condition: when adopting provisional measures under paragraph 1
units.proposition: When adopting provisional measures under Article 66(1), the supervisory authority concerned shall specify a period of validity for those measures.

units.action: set a period of validity for provisional measures that exceeds three months
units.scope: provisional measures under Article 66(1)
units.condition: when specifying the period of validity for provisional measures under paragraph 1
units.proposition: The supervisory authority concerned shall not set a period of validity for provisional measures under Article 66(1) that exceeds three months.

units.action: request an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision from the Board
units.scope: urgent opinion or urgent binding decision
units.condition: after taking a measure pursuant to paragraph 1 and considering that final measures need urgently be adopted
units.proposition: Where a supervisory authority has taken a measure pursuant to Article 66(1) and considers that final measures need urgently be adopted, it may request an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision from the Board.

units.action: give reasons for requesting the urgent opinion or urgent binding decision
units.condition: when making a request under paragraph 2
units.proposition: A supervisory authority that requests an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision under Article 66(2) shall give reasons for the request.

units.action: request an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision from the Board
units.scope: urgent opinion or urgent binding decision
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority has not taken an appropriate measure in a situation where there is an urgent need to act to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects
units.proposition: Any supervisory authority may request an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision from the Board where a competent supervisory authority has not taken an appropriate measure in a situation where there is an urgent need to act to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

units.action: give reasons for requesting the urgent opinion or urgent binding decision, including for the urgent need to act
units.condition: when making a request under paragraph 3
units.proposition: A supervisory authority that requests an urgent opinion or an urgent binding decision under Article 66(3) shall give reasons for the request, including for the urgent need to act.

units.action: adopt the urgent opinion or urgent binding decision referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 by simple majority of its members
units.scope: urgent opinions or urgent binding decisions referred to in Article 66(2) and (3)
units.exception: by derogation from Article 64(3) and Article 65(2)
units.temporal: within two weeks
units.proposition: By derogation from Articles 64(3) and 65(2), the European Data Protection Board shall adopt, within two weeks and by simple majority of its members, the urgent opinion or urgent binding decision referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3.

units.action: adopt a binding decision
units.scope: individual case under the cooperation procedure
units.condition: where, in a case referred to in Article 60(4), a supervisory authority concerned has raised a relevant and reasoned objection to a draft decision of the lead authority, or the lead authority has rejected such an objection as not relevant or not reasoned
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to adopt a binding decision where, in a case under Article 60(4), a supervisory authority concerned has raised a relevant and reasoned objection to a draft decision of the lead authority, or the lead authority has rejected such an objection as not relevant or reasoned.

units.action: ensure its binding decision concerns all matters that are the subject of the relevant and reasoned objection, including whether there is an infringement of the Regulation
units.scope: content of the binding decision under point (a)
units.condition: in the situation referred to in paragraph 1(a)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, in the situation referred to in paragraph 1(a), to ensure its binding decision concerns all matters that are the subject of the relevant and reasoned objection, including whether there is an infringement of the Regulation.

units.action: adopt a binding decision
units.scope: dispute on competence for the main establishment
units.condition: where there are conflicting views on which of the supervisory authorities concerned is competent for the main establishment
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to adopt a binding decision where there are conflicting views on which of the supervisory authorities concerned is competent for the main establishment.

units.action: adopt a binding decision
units.scope: failure to involve or follow the Board's opinion under Article 64
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority does not request the opinion of the Board in cases referred to in Article 64(1) or does not follow the opinion of the Board issued under Article 64
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to adopt a binding decision where a competent supervisory authority does not request the Board’s opinion in cases referred to in Article 64(1) or does not follow the Board’s opinion issued under Article 64.

units.addressee: any supervisory authority concerned or the European Commission
units.action: communicate the matter to the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: escalation of the situation described in paragraph 1(c)
units.condition: where a competent supervisory authority does not request the Board’s opinion under Article 64(1) or does not follow the Board’s opinion issued under Article 64
units.proposition: Any supervisory authority concerned or the European Commission is permitted to communicate the matter to the European Data Protection Board where a competent supervisory authority does not request the Board’s opinion under Article 64(1) or does not follow the Board’s opinion issued under Article 64.

units.action: adopt the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: decision-making rule: by a two-thirds majority of the members of the Board
units.condition: upon referral of the subject-matter under paragraph 1
units.exception: the period may be extended by a further month on account of the complexity of the subject-matter
units.temporal: within one month from the referral of the subject-matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, upon referral of the subject-matter under paragraph 1, to adopt the decision by a two-thirds majority within one month from the referral, unless the period is extended by a further month on account of the complexity of the subject-matter.

units.action: extend the one-month period for adopting the decision by a further month
units.scope: time limit for the decision under paragraph 1
units.condition: on account of the complexity of the subject-matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is permitted, on account of the complexity of the subject-matter, to extend by a further month the one-month period for adopting the decision under paragraph 1.

units.action: provide reasons for the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: form of the decision
units.condition: when adopting the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, when adopting the decision referred to in paragraph 1, to provide reasons for that decision.

units.action: address the decision referred to in paragraph 1 to the lead supervisory authority and all the supervisory authorities concerned
units.scope: recipients of the decision
units.condition: when adopting the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, when adopting the decision referred to in paragraph 1, to address it to the lead supervisory authority and all the supervisory authorities concerned.

units.action: adopt its decision by a simple majority of the members of the Board
units.scope: fallback decision-making rule
units.condition: where the Board has been unable to adopt a decision within the periods referred to in paragraph 2
units.temporal: within two weeks following the expiration of the second month referred to in paragraph 2
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, where it has been unable to adopt a decision within the periods referred to in paragraph 2, to adopt its decision by a simple majority within two weeks following the expiration of the second month referred to in paragraph 2.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: adopt the decision by casting the deciding vote
units.scope: tie-break in Board voting
units.condition: where the members of the Board are split
units.temporal: at the time of the vote
units.proposition: The Chair of the European Data Protection Board has the power, where the members of the Board are split, to adopt the decision by casting the deciding vote.

units.action: adopt a decision on the subject-matter submitted to the Board under paragraph 1
units.scope: same subject-matter as referred to the Board
units.condition: after submission of the subject-matter to the Board under paragraph 1
units.temporal: during the periods referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3
units.proposition: The supervisory authorities concerned are prohibited, after the subject-matter has been submitted to the Board under paragraph 1, from adopting a decision on that subject-matter during the periods referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: notify the decision referred to in paragraph 1 to the supervisory authorities concerned
units.scope: notification duty
units.condition: after the Board has adopted the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.temporal: without undue delay
units.proposition: The Chair of the European Data Protection Board is obliged, after the Board has adopted the decision referred to in paragraph 1, to notify that decision to the supervisory authorities concerned without undue delay.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: inform the European Commission of the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: information duty
units.condition: after the Board has adopted the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.proposition: The Chair of the European Data Protection Board is obliged, after the Board has adopted the decision referred to in paragraph 1, to inform the European Commission thereof.

units.action: publish the decision referred to in paragraph 1 on the website of the Board
units.scope: publication duty
units.condition: after a supervisory authority has notified the final decision referred to in paragraph 6
units.temporal: without delay after such notification
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged, after a supervisory authority has notified the final decision referred to in paragraph 6, to publish the decision referred to in paragraph 1 on its website without delay.

units.addressee: lead supervisory authority or the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: adopt its final decision on the basis of the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: implementation of the Board’s decision
units.condition: after the Board has notified its decision
units.temporal: without undue delay and at the latest by one month after the Board has notified its decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority or, as the case may be, the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged is obliged, after the Board has notified its decision, to adopt its final decision on the basis of the decision referred to in paragraph 1 without undue delay and at the latest by one month thereafter.

units.addressee: lead supervisory authority or the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: inform the Board of the date when its final decision is notified to the controller or the processor and to the data subject
units.scope: reporting duty
units.condition: when it has notified its final decision to the controller or the processor and to the data subject
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority or, as the case may be, the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged is obliged, when it has notified its final decision to the controller or the processor and to the data subject, to inform the Board of the date of that notification.

units.action: adopt the final decision under the terms of Article 60(7), (8) and (9)
units.scope: applicable procedure for adoption
units.condition: when adopting the final decision
