units.proposition: The supervisory authorities concerned are obliged, when adopting the final decision, to do so under the terms of Article 60(7), (8) and (9).

units.addressee: lead supervisory authority or the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: include a reference in the final decision to the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: content of the final decision
units.condition: when drafting the final decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority or, as the case may be, the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged is obliged, when drafting the final decision, to include a reference to the decision referred to in paragraph 1.

units.addressee: lead supervisory authority or the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: specify in the final decision that the decision referred to in paragraph 1 will be published on the website of the Board in accordance with paragraph 5
units.scope: content of the final decision
units.condition: when drafting the final decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority or, as the case may be, the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged is obliged, when drafting the final decision, to specify that the decision referred to in paragraph 1 will be published on the website of the Board in accordance with paragraph 5.

units.addressee: lead supervisory authority or the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: attach to the final decision the decision referred to in paragraph 1
units.scope: annex to the final decision
units.condition: when issuing the final decision
units.proposition: The lead supervisory authority or, as the case may be, the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged is obliged, when issuing the final decision, to attach the decision referred to in paragraph 1.

units.action: conduct joint operations, including joint investigations and joint enforcement measures, involving members or staff of supervisory authorities of other Member States
units.scope: joint operations across Member States
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities shall, where appropriate, conduct joint operations, including joint investigations and joint enforcement measures, involving members or staff of supervisory authorities of other Member States.

units.addressee: supervisory authority of each Member State concerned
units.action: participate in joint operations
units.scope: Member States where the controller or processor has establishments or where data subjects are likely to be substantially affected
units.condition: the controller or processor has establishments in several Member States, or a significant number of data subjects in more than one Member State are likely to be substantially affected by processing operations
units.proposition: A supervisory authority of each concerned Member State has the right to participate in joint operations when the controller or processor has establishments in several Member States or when a significant number of data subjects in more than one Member State are likely to be substantially affected by processing operations.

units.addressee: supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 56(1) or (4)
units.action: invite the supervisory authority of each concerned Member State to take part in the joint operations
units.scope: joint operations under Article 62(2)
units.condition: the controller or processor has establishments in several Member States, or a significant number of data subjects in more than one Member State are likely to be substantially affected by processing operations
units.consequence: If it does not comply within one month, other supervisory authorities may adopt provisional measures on their territory under Article 55; in that case, the urgent need to act under Article 66(1) is presumed and an opinion or urgent binding decision from the Board under Article 66(2) is required.
units.proposition: The supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 56(1) or (4) shall invite the supervisory authority of each concerned Member State to take part in the joint operations when the conditions in Article 62(2) are met.

units.addressee: supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 56(1) or (4)
units.action: respond to a request of a supervisory authority to participate in the joint operations
units.scope: participation requests in joint operations
units.condition: upon receiving a request from a supervisory authority to participate in joint operations under Article 62(2)
units.temporal: without delay
units.consequence: If it does not comply within one month, other supervisory authorities may adopt provisional measures on their territory under Article 55; in that case, the urgent need to act under Article 66(1) is presumed and an opinion or urgent binding decision from the Board under Article 66(2) is required.
units.proposition: The supervisory authority competent pursuant to Article 56(1) or (4) shall respond without delay to a request from a supervisory authority to participate in joint operations.

units.action: confer powers, including investigative powers, on the seconding supervisory authority's members or staff involved in joint operations
units.scope: members or staff of a seconding supervisory authority involved in joint operations
units.condition: in accordance with Member State law and with the seconding supervisory authority’s authorisation
units.proposition: A host supervisory authority may, in accordance with Member State law and with the seconding supervisory authority’s authorisation, confer powers, including investigative powers, on the seconding supervisory authority’s members or staff involved in joint operations.

units.action: allow the seconding supervisory authority's members or staff to exercise their investigative powers in the host Member State
units.scope: joint operations
units.condition: insofar as the law of the host supervisory authority’s Member State permits and in accordance with the law of the Member State of the seconding supervisory authority
units.proposition: A host supervisory authority may, insofar as the law of its Member State permits, allow the seconding supervisory authority’s members or staff to exercise their investigative powers in accordance with the law of the Member State of the seconding supervisory authority.

units.addressee: members or staff of a seconding supervisory authority exercising investigative powers
units.action: exercise investigative powers without the guidance and presence of members or staff of the host supervisory authority
units.scope: investigative powers exercised during joint operations
units.condition: when exercising investigative powers under Article 62(3)
units.proposition: Members or staff of a seconding supervisory authority shall not exercise investigative powers during joint operations unless under the guidance and in the presence of members or staff of the host supervisory authority.

units.addressee: members or staff of a seconding supervisory authority operating in another Member State
units.action: act in accordance with the Member State law of the host supervisory authority
units.scope: operations in the territory of the host supervisory authority
units.condition: when participating in joint operations in another Member State
units.proposition: Members or staff of a seconding supervisory authority operating in another Member State shall be subject to, and act in accordance with, the Member State law of the host supervisory authority.

units.addressee: Member State of the host supervisory authority
units.action: assume responsibility for the actions of the seconding supervisory authority’s staff, including liability for any damage they cause during their operations
units.scope: staff of a seconding supervisory authority operating in its territory
units.condition: where, in accordance with Article 62(1), staff of a seconding supervisory authority operate in another Member State
units.proposition: The Member State of the host supervisory authority shall assume responsibility for the actions of the seconding supervisory authority’s staff, including liability for any damage they cause during their operations, in accordance with the law of the Member State in whose territory they are operating.

units.addressee: Member State in whose territory the damage was caused
units.action: make good the damage caused by the seconding supervisory authority’s staff
units.scope: damage referred to in Article 62(4)
units.condition: damage was caused in its territory during operations by staff of a seconding supervisory authority under Article 62(1)
units.proposition: The Member State in whose territory the damage was caused shall make good such damage under the conditions applicable to damage caused by its own staff.

units.addressee: Member State of the seconding supervisory authority
units.action: reimburse in full any sums paid to entitled persons by the other Member State
units.scope: damage caused by its staff in the territory of another Member State
units.condition: its staff has caused damage to any person in the territory of another Member State and that other Member State has paid sums to the persons entitled
units.proposition: The Member State of the seconding supervisory authority whose staff has caused damage to any person in the territory of another Member State shall reimburse that other Member State in full any sums it has paid to the persons entitled.

units.action: request reimbursement from another Member State in relation to damage referred to in Article 62(4)
units.scope: case provided for in Article 62(1)
units.condition: in cases of joint operations under Article 62(1) and damage referred to in Article 62(4)
units.exception: without prejudice to the exercise of rights vis-à-vis third parties; except as provided in Article 62(5)
units.proposition: Without prejudice to the exercise of its rights vis-à-vis third parties and except as provided in Article 62(5), each Member State shall refrain, in the case provided for in Article 62(1), from requesting reimbursement from another Member State in relation to damage referred to in Article 62(4).

units.action: adopt a provisional measure on the territory of their Member State in accordance with Article 55
units.scope: where a joint operation is intended
units.condition: a supervisory authority has not, within one month, complied with the obligation in the second sentence of Article 62(2)
units.temporal: after one month of non-compliance
units.consequence: In that case, the urgent need to act under Article 66(1) is presumed and an opinion or urgent binding decision from the Board pursuant to Article 66(2) is required.
units.proposition: Where a joint operation is intended and a supervisory authority does not comply within one month with the obligation in the second sentence of Article 62(2), the other supervisory authorities may adopt a provisional measure on the territory of their Member State in accordance with Article 55.

units.action: provide an opinion or adopt an urgent binding decision pursuant to Article 66(2)
units.scope: cases where other supervisory authorities adopt a provisional measure under Article 62(7)
units.condition: a joint operation was intended and a supervisory authority failed to comply within one month with the obligation in the second sentence of Article 62(2), leading to adoption of a provisional measure
units.proposition: In the case where other supervisory authorities adopt a provisional measure under Article 62(7), the European Data Protection Board shall provide an opinion or adopt an urgent binding decision pursuant to Article 66(2).

units.ru_label: Commission may adopt acts for info exchange
units.action: adopt implementing acts of general scope to specify arrangements for the exchange of information by electronic means between supervisory authorities and between supervisory authorities and the European Data Protection Board, including the standardised format referred to in Article 64
units.scope: Arrangements and standardised formats for electronic information exchange between supervisory authorities and between supervisory authorities and the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: The European Commission has the power to adopt implementing acts of general scope to specify arrangements, including the standardised format referred to in Article 64, for the electronic exchange of information between supervisory authorities and between supervisory authorities and the European Data Protection Board.

units.ru_label: Commission must use examination procedure for those acts
units.action: adopt the implementing acts under Article 67 in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2)
units.scope: Implementing acts specifying arrangements for electronic information exchange under Article 67
units.condition: When adopting those implementing acts
units.proposition: When adopting the implementing acts under Article 67, the European Commission is obliged to follow the examination procedure referred to in Article 93(2).

units.action: act independently
units.scope: performance of tasks and exercise of powers pursuant to Articles 70 and 71
units.temporal: when performing its tasks or exercising its powers pursuant to Articles 70 and 71
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to act independently when performing its tasks or exercising its powers pursuant to Articles 70 and 71.

units.action: seek instructions from anybody
units.scope: performance of its tasks or exercise of its powers
units.exception: Without prejudice to requests by the Commission referred to in point (b) of Article 70(1) and in Article 70(2)
units.temporal: in the performance of its tasks or the exercise of its powers
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is prohibited from seeking instructions from anybody when performing its tasks or exercising its powers, without prejudice to requests by the Commission referred to in point (b) of Article 70(1) and in Article 70(2).

units.action: take instructions from anybody
units.scope: performance of its tasks or exercise of its powers
units.exception: Without prejudice to requests by the Commission referred to in point (b) of Article 70(1) and in Article 70(2)
units.temporal: in the performance of its tasks or the exercise of its powers
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is prohibited from taking instructions from anybody when performing its tasks or exercising its powers, without prejudice to requests by the Commission referred to in point (b) of Article 70(1) and in Article 70(2).

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: represent the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: representation of the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: The Chair of the European Data Protection Board has the power to represent the Board.

units.addressee: Member State with more than one supervisory authority responsible under the GDPR
units.action: appoint a joint representative in accordance with its law
units.scope: representation of that Member State’s supervisory authorities on the Board
units.condition: Where in a Member State more than one supervisory authority is responsible for monitoring application of the GDPR
units.proposition: Where a Member State has more than one supervisory authority, that Member State must appoint a joint representative in accordance with its law.

units.action: participate in the activities and meetings of the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: activities and meetings of the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: The European Commission has the right to participate in the activities and meetings of the European Data Protection Board.

units.action: vote in the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: activities and meetings of the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: The European Commission is prohibited from voting in the European Data Protection Board.

units.action: designate a representative to the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: participation in the activities and meetings of the Board
units.proposition: The European Commission must designate a representative for its participation in the European Data Protection Board.

units.addressee: Chair of the European Data Protection Board
units.action: communicate the activities of the Board to the European Commission
units.scope: activities of the European Data Protection Board
units.proposition: The Chair of the European Data Protection Board must communicate the activities of the Board to the European Commission.

units.action: vote on decisions of the European Data Protection Board
units.scope: decisions that concern principles and rules applicable to Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies which correspond in substance to those of the GDPR
units.condition: In the cases referred to in Article 65
units.proposition: In the cases referred to in Article 65, the European Data Protection Supervisor has the right to vote on decisions that concern principles and rules applicable to Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies corresponding in substance to those of the GDPR.

units.action: vote on decisions of the European Data Protection Board other than those that concern principles and rules applicable to Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies which correspond in substance to those of the GDPR
units.scope: decisions in the cases referred to in Article 65
units.condition: In the cases referred to in Article 65
units.proposition: In the cases referred to in Article 65, the European Data Protection Supervisor is prohibited from voting on decisions other than those that concern principles and rules applicable to Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies corresponding in substance to those of the GDPR.

units.action: take decisions by a simple majority of its members
units.exception: unless otherwise provided for in this Regulation
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to take decisions by a simple majority of its members, unless otherwise provided for in this Regulation.

units.ru_label: Adopt rules of procedure by two-thirds majority
units.action: adopt its own rules of procedure by a two-thirds majority of its members
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to adopt its own rules of procedure by a two-thirds majority of its members.

units.action: organise its own operational arrangements
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to organise its own operational arrangements.

units.action: draw up an annual report on the protection of natural persons with regard to processing
units.scope: geographical coverage: the Union; and, for coverage of third countries and international organisations, where relevant
units.condition: where relevant (for coverage of third countries and international organisations)
units.temporal: annually
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to draw up an annual report on the protection of natural persons with regard to processing in the Union and, where relevant, in third countries and international organisations.

units.action: make the annual report public
units.scope: the annual report referred to in Article 71(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to make the annual report public.

units.ru_label: Board transmit annual report to EU institutions
units.action: transmit the annual report to the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission
units.scope: the annual report referred to in Article 71(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to transmit the annual report to the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission.

units.ru_label: Board include review of guidelines etc.
units.action: include in the annual report a review of the practical application of the guidelines, recommendations and best practices referred to in Article 70(1)(l)
units.scope: content of the annual report
units.temporal: in each annual report
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to include in the annual report a review of the practical application of the guidelines, recommendations and best practices referred to in Article 70(1)(l).

units.ru_label: Board include review of binding decisions
units.action: include in the annual report a review of the binding decisions referred to in Article 65
units.scope: content of the annual report
units.temporal: in each annual report
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to include in the annual report a review of the binding decisions referred to in Article 65.

units.action: ensure the consistent application of the GDPR
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall ensure the consistent application of the GDPR.

units.action: monitor the correct application of the GDPR
units.scope: in the cases provided for in Articles 64 and 65
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks of national supervisory authorities
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall monitor the correct application of the GDPR in the cases provided for in Articles 64 and 65, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission, without prejudice to the tasks of national supervisory authorities.

units.action: ensure the correct application of the GDPR
units.scope: in the cases provided for in Articles 64 and 65
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks of national supervisory authorities
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall ensure the correct application of the GDPR in the cases provided for in Articles 64 and 65, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission, without prejudice to the tasks of national supervisory authorities.

units.action: advise the European Commission on issues related to the protection of personal data in the Union
units.scope: including on any proposed amendment of the GDPR
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall advise the European Commission on any issue related to the protection of personal data in the Union, including on any proposed amendment of the GDPR, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: advise the European Commission on the format and procedures for the exchange of information
units.scope: between controllers, processors and supervisory authorities for binding corporate rules
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall advise the European Commission on the format and procedures for the exchange of information between controllers, processors and supervisory authorities for binding corporate rules, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue guidelines on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services
units.scope: as referred to in Article 17(2)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services as referred to in Article 17(2), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue recommendations on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services
units.scope: as referred to in Article 17(2)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services as referred to in Article 17(2), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue best practices on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services
units.scope: as referred to in Article 17(2)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices on procedures for erasing links, copies or replications of personal data from publicly available communication services as referred to in Article 17(2), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: examine any question covering the application of the GDPR
units.condition: on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall examine any question covering the application of the GDPR on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue guidelines to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR
units.condition: on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines in order to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue recommendations to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR
units.condition: on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations in order to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue best practices to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR
units.condition: on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices in order to encourage the consistent application of the GDPR on its own initiative, on request of one of its members, or on request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue guidelines for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling
units.scope: pursuant to Article 22(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling pursuant to Article 22(2).

units.action: issue recommendations for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling
units.scope: pursuant to Article 22(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling pursuant to Article 22(2).

units.action: issue best practices for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling
units.scope: pursuant to Article 22(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for further specifying the criteria and conditions for decisions based on profiling pursuant to Article 22(2).

units.action: issue guidelines for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay, and identifying circumstances requiring breach notification
units.scope: as referred to in Article 33(1) and (2) and for the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay referred to in Article 33(1) and (2), and identifying the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach.

units.action: issue recommendations for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay, and identifying circumstances requiring breach notification
units.scope: as referred to in Article 33(1) and (2) and for the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay referred to in Article 33(1) and (2), and identifying the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach.

units.action: issue best practices for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay, and identifying circumstances requiring breach notification
units.scope: as referred to in Article 33(1) and (2) and for the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing personal data breaches, determining the undue delay referred to in Article 33(1) and (2), and identifying the particular circumstances in which a controller or a processor is required to notify the personal data breach.

units.action: issue guidelines on circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.scope: as referred to in Article 34(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), on the circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons as referred to in Article 34(1).

units.action: issue recommendations on circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.scope: as referred to in Article 34(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), on the circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons as referred to in Article 34(1).

units.action: issue best practices on circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.scope: as referred to in Article 34(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), on the circumstances in which a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons as referred to in Article 34(1).

units.action: issue guidelines specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules and further necessary requirements to ensure protection of personal data
units.scope: for binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and by processors, and to ensure protection of personal data of data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and binding corporate rules adhered to by processors, and on further necessary requirements to ensure the protection of personal data of the data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47.

units.action: issue recommendations specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules and further necessary requirements to ensure protection of personal data
units.scope: for binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and by processors, and to ensure protection of personal data of data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and binding corporate rules adhered to by processors, and on further necessary requirements to ensure the protection of personal data of the data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47.

units.action: issue best practices specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules and further necessary requirements to ensure protection of personal data
units.scope: for binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and by processors, and to ensure protection of personal data of data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers based on binding corporate rules adhered to by controllers and binding corporate rules adhered to by processors, and on further necessary requirements to ensure the protection of personal data of the data subjects concerned referred to in Article 47.

units.action: issue guidelines specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers
units.scope: on the basis of Article 49(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers on the basis of Article 49(1).

units.action: issue recommendations specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers
units.scope: on the basis of Article 49(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers on the basis of Article 49(1).

units.action: issue best practices specifying criteria and requirements for personal data transfers
units.scope: on the basis of Article 49(1)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for the purpose of further specifying the criteria and requirements for personal data transfers on the basis of Article 49(1).

units.action: draw up guidelines for supervisory authorities concerning the application of measures and the setting of administrative fines
units.scope: measures referred to in Article 58(1), (2) and (3), and administrative fines pursuant to Article 83
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall draw up guidelines for supervisory authorities concerning the application of measures referred to in Article 58(1), (2) and (3) and the setting of administrative fines pursuant to Article 83, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: review the practical application of its guidelines, recommendations and best practices
units.scope: those referred to in points (e) and (f) of Article 70(1)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall review the practical application of the guidelines, recommendations and best practices referred to in points (e) and (f) of Article 70(1), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: issue guidelines for establishing common procedures for reporting infringements by natural persons
units.scope: pursuant to Article 54(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue guidelines, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing common procedures for reporting by natural persons of infringements of the GDPR pursuant to Article 54(2).

units.action: issue recommendations for establishing common procedures for reporting infringements by natural persons
units.scope: pursuant to Article 54(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue recommendations, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing common procedures for reporting by natural persons of infringements of the GDPR pursuant to Article 54(2).

units.action: issue best practices for establishing common procedures for reporting infringements by natural persons
units.scope: pursuant to Article 54(2)
units.condition: in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue best practices, in accordance with point (e) of Article 70(1), for establishing common procedures for reporting by natural persons of infringements of the GDPR pursuant to Article 54(2).

units.action: encourage the drawing-up of codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall encourage the drawing-up of codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: encourage the establishment of data protection certification mechanisms and data protection seals and marks
units.scope: pursuant to Article 42
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall encourage the establishment of data protection certification mechanisms and data protection seals and marks pursuant to Article 42, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: carry out the accreditation of certification bodies
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall carry out the accreditation of certification bodies pursuant to Article 43, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: carry out the periodic review of the accreditation of certification bodies
units.scope: pursuant to Article 43
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.temporal: periodically
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall carry out the periodic review of the accreditation of certification bodies pursuant to Article 43, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: maintain a public register of accredited bodies and of accredited controllers or processors established in third countries
units.scope: accredited bodies pursuant to Article 43(6) and accredited controllers or processors established in third countries pursuant to Article 42(7)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall maintain a public register of accredited bodies pursuant to Article 43(6) and of the accredited controllers or processors established in third countries pursuant to Article 42(7), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: specify the requirements referred to in Article 43(3) with a view to the accreditation of certification bodies
units.scope: under Article 42
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall specify the requirements referred to in Article 43(3) with a view to the accreditation of certification bodies under Article 42, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: provide the European Commission with an opinion on the certification requirements
units.scope: referred to in Article 43(8)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall provide the European Commission with an opinion on the certification requirements referred to in Article 43(8), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: provide the European Commission with an opinion on the icons
units.scope: referred to in Article 12(7)
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall provide the European Commission with an opinion on the icons referred to in Article 12(7), on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: provide the European Commission with an opinion for the assessment of the adequacy of the level of protection
units.scope: in a third country or an international organisation, including assessment whether a third country, a territory or specified sectors, or an international organisation no longer ensures an adequate level of protection
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall provide the European Commission with an opinion for the assessment of the adequacy of the level of protection in a third country or international organisation, including for the assessment whether a third country, a territory or one or more specified sectors within that third country, or an international organisation no longer ensures an adequate level of protection, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: provide the European Data Protection Board with all necessary documentation
units.scope: including correspondence with the government of the third country, with regard to the third country, territory or specified sector, or with the international organisation
units.condition: for the Board’s adequacy opinion under point (s) of Article 70(1)
units.proposition: The European Commission shall provide the European Data Protection Board with all necessary documentation, including correspondence with the government of the third country, with regard to that third country, territory or specified sector, or with the international organisation, for the Board’s adequacy opinion under point (s) of Article 70(1).

units.action: issue opinions on draft decisions of supervisory authorities pursuant to the consistency mechanism
units.condition: on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue opinions on draft decisions of supervisory authorities pursuant to the consistency mechanism, on its own initiative or, where relevant, at the request of the European Commission.

units.action: convene the meetings of the Board
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board is obligated to convene the meetings of the Board.

units.action: prepare the agenda of the Board's meetings
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board is obligated to prepare the agenda of the Board's meetings.

units.action: notify decisions to the lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned
units.scope: decisions adopted by the Board pursuant to Article 65
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board is obligated to notify decisions adopted by the Board pursuant to Article 65 to the lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned.

units.action: ensure the timely performance of the tasks of the Board
units.scope: in particular in relation to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63
units.proposition: The Chair of the Board is obligated to ensure the timely performance of the tasks of the Board, in particular in relation to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63.

units.action: lay down in its rules of procedure the allocation of tasks between the Chair and the deputy chairs
units.proposition: The Board is obligated to lay down in its rules of procedure the allocation of tasks between the Chair and the deputy chairs.

units.action: obtain an effective judicial remedy before a court
units.scope: against a legally binding decision of a supervisory authority concerning the person
units.exception: Without prejudice to any other administrative or non-judicial remedy
units.proposition: Each natural or legal person has the right to obtain an effective judicial remedy before a court against a legally binding decision of a supervisory authority concerning them.

units.action: obtain an effective judicial remedy before a court
units.scope: regarding a complaint lodged under Article 77
units.condition: where the supervisory authority competent under Articles 55 and 56 does not handle the complaint or does not inform the data subject on its progress or outcome within three months
units.exception: Without prejudice to any other administrative or non-judicial remedy
units.proposition: Each data subject has the right to obtain an effective judicial remedy before a court regarding a complaint lodged under Article 77 where the supervisory authority competent under Articles 55 and 56 does not handle the complaint or does not inform the data subject on its progress or outcome within three months.

units.addressee: any person bringing proceedings against a supervisory authority
units.action: bring the proceedings before the courts of the Member State where the supervisory authority is established
units.scope: proceedings against a supervisory authority
units.proposition: Any person bringing proceedings against a supervisory authority must bring the proceedings before the courts of the Member State where that supervisory authority is established.

units.addressee: the supervisory authority whose decision is challenged
units.action: forward the Board's opinion or decision to the court
units.scope: the opinion or decision of the Board issued in the consistency mechanism that preceded the supervisory authority's decision
units.condition: where proceedings are brought against a decision of the supervisory authority that was preceded by an opinion or decision of the Board in the consistency mechanism
units.proposition: Where proceedings are brought against a decision of a supervisory authority that was preceded by an opinion or decision of the Board in the consistency mechanism, that supervisory authority must forward that opinion or decision to the court.

units.action: keep its discussions confidential
units.scope: discussions of the Board
units.condition: where the Board deems it necessary, as provided for in its rules of procedure
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to keep its discussions confidential where it deems this necessary in accordance with its rules of procedure.

units.action: apply Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001 to govern access to documents
units.scope: access to documents submitted to members of the Board, experts and representatives of third parties
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to apply Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001 to govern access to documents submitted to members of the Board, experts and representatives of third parties.

units.action: lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
units.scope: in particular with a supervisory authority in the Member State of the data subject's habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement
units.condition: if the data subject considers that the processing of personal data relating to him or her infringes this Regulation
units.proposition: Every data subject has the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of his or her habitual residence, place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement, if the data subject considers that the processing of personal data relating to him or her infringes this Regulation.

units.addressee: the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: inform the complainant on the progress of the complaint
units.condition: if a complaint has been lodged with the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged shall inform the complainant on the progress of the complaint.

units.addressee: the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: inform the complainant on the outcome of the complaint
units.condition: if a complaint has been lodged with the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged shall inform the complainant on the outcome of the complaint.

units.addressee: the supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged
units.action: inform the complainant of the possibility of a judicial remedy pursuant to Article 78
units.condition: if a complaint has been lodged with the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The supervisory authority with which the complaint has been lodged shall inform the complainant of the possibility of a judicial remedy pursuant to Article 78.

units.action: elect a chair
units.scope: from amongst its members; by simple majority
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall elect a chair from amongst its members by simple majority.

units.action: elect two deputy chairs
units.scope: from amongst its members; by simple majority
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall elect two deputy chairs from amongst its members by simple majority.

units.ru_label: Chair and deputies serve five-year term
units.addressee: Chair and deputy chairs of the EDPB
units.action: serve a term of office
units.temporal: five years
units.proposition: The term of office of the Chair and of the deputy chairs shall be five years.

units.action: renew the term of office of the Chair or deputy chairs once
units.scope: for the Chair and the deputy chairs
units.proposition: The term of office of the Chair and of the deputy chairs may be renewed once.

units.action: have a secretariat
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board is obliged to have a secretariat.

units.ru_label: EDPS must provide the Board’s secretariat
units.action: provide the Board’s secretariat
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Supervisor is obliged to provide the Board’s secretariat.

units.ru_label: Secretariat acts only under Chair’s instructions
units.action: perform its tasks
units.scope: exclusively under the instructions of the Chair of the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to perform its tasks exclusively under the instructions of the Chair of the Board.

units.ru_label: EDPS staff (Board tasks) have separate reporting lines
units.addressee: Staff of the European Data Protection Supervisor involved in Board tasks
units.action: be subject to separate reporting lines
units.scope: separate from staff involved in carrying out tasks conferred on the European Data Protection Supervisor
units.condition: when involved in carrying out tasks conferred on the Board by this Regulation
units.proposition: Staff of the European Data Protection Supervisor who are involved in carrying out the tasks conferred on the Board by this Regulation are obliged to be subject to separate reporting lines from staff involved in carrying out tasks conferred on the European Data Protection Supervisor.

units.ru_label: EDPB and EDPS must establish MoU (where appropriate)
units.addressee: European Data Protection Board and European Data Protection Supervisor
units.action: establish a Memorandum of Understanding
units.scope: implementing Article 75, determining the terms of their cooperation, and applicable to EDPS staff involved in carrying out tasks conferred on the Board
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Where appropriate, the European Data Protection Board and the European Data Protection Supervisor are obliged to establish a Memorandum of Understanding implementing Article 75 that determines the terms of their cooperation and applies to EDPS staff involved in carrying out Board tasks.

units.ru_label: EDPB and EDPS must publish MoU (where appropriate)
units.addressee: European Data Protection Board and European Data Protection Supervisor
units.action: publish the Memorandum of Understanding
units.scope: that implements Article 75, determines the terms of their cooperation, and applies to EDPS staff involved in carrying out tasks conferred on the Board
units.condition: where appropriate
units.proposition: Where appropriate, the European Data Protection Board and the European Data Protection Supervisor are obliged to publish the Memorandum of Understanding implementing Article 75 that determines the terms of their cooperation and applies to EDPS staff involved in carrying out Board tasks.

units.ru_label: Secretariat provides support to the Board
units.action: provide support to the Board
units.scope: analytical, administrative and logistical
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to provide analytical, administrative and logistical support to the Board.

units.action: manage the day-to-day business of the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to manage the day-to-day business of the Board.

units.action: handle communication
units.scope: between the members of the Board, its Chair and the Commission
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to handle communication between the members of the Board, its Chair and the Commission.

units.ru_label: Secretariat handles communication with institutions and public
units.action: handle communication
units.scope: with other institutions and the public
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to handle communication with other institutions and the public.

units.action: manage the use of electronic means for communication
units.scope: for internal and external communication
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to manage the use of electronic means for internal and external communication.

units.action: translate information
units.scope: relevant information
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to translate relevant information.

units.action: prepare the meetings of the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to prepare the meetings of the Board.

units.action: follow up the meetings of the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to follow up the meetings of the Board.

units.ru_label: Secretariat prepares opinions, dispute-settlement decisions, other texts
units.action: prepare documents adopted by the Board
units.scope: opinions; decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities; other texts adopted by the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to prepare opinions, decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities, and other texts adopted by the Board.

units.ru_label: Secretariat drafts opinions, dispute-settlement decisions, other texts
units.action: draft documents adopted by the Board
units.scope: opinions; decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities; other texts adopted by the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to draft opinions, decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities, and other texts adopted by the Board.

units.ru_label: Secretariat publishes opinions, dispute-settlement decisions, other texts
units.action: publish documents adopted by the Board
units.scope: opinions; decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities; other texts adopted by the Board
units.proposition: The Board secretariat is obliged to publish opinions, decisions on the settlement of disputes between supervisory authorities, and other texts adopted by the Board.

units.addressee: a competent court of a Member State
units.action: contact the court in the other Member State to confirm the existence of the parallel proceedings
units.scope: proceedings concerning the same subject matter as regards processing by the same controller or processor
units.condition: the court has information that such proceedings are pending in a court in another Member State
units.proposition: A competent court of a Member State must contact the court in another Member State to confirm the existence of parallel proceedings when it has information that proceedings concerning the same subject matter as regards processing by the same controller or processor are pending there.

units.addressee: any competent court other than the court first seized
units.action: suspend its proceedings
units.scope: proceedings concerning the same subject matter as regards processing by the same controller or processor
units.condition: such proceedings are pending in a court in another Member State
units.proposition: Any competent court other than the court first seized may suspend its proceedings when proceedings concerning the same subject matter as regards processing by the same controller or processor are pending in a court in another Member State.

units.addressee: any court other than the court first seized
units.action: decline jurisdiction
units.scope: actions in question relating to the same subject matter of processing by the same controller or processor
units.condition: a party applies; the court first seized has jurisdiction over the actions in question; and the law of the court first seized permits consolidation of those actions
units.temporal: when the proceedings in the other Member State are pending at first instance
units.proposition: Any court other than the court first seized may, on application of a party, decline jurisdiction when the proceedings in the other Member State are pending at first instance, the court first seized has jurisdiction over the actions in question, and its law permits consolidation.

units.action: seek an effective judicial remedy before a court against a controller or processor
units.scope: in addition to any available administrative or non-judicial remedies, including the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority under Article 77
units.condition: the data subject considers that his or her rights under the GDPR have been infringed as a result of processing of his or her personal data in non-compliance with the GDPR
units.proposition: Each data subject has the right to seek an effective judicial remedy against a controller or processor when they consider that their GDPR rights have been infringed due to non-compliant processing of their personal data, in addition to any available administrative or non-judicial remedies including the right to lodge a complaint under Article 77.

units.action: bring proceedings against a controller or processor before the courts of the Member State where the controller or processor has an establishment
units.scope: judicial proceedings under Article 79
units.proposition: A data subject has the power to bring proceedings against a controller or processor before the courts of the Member State where the controller or processor has an establishment.

units.ru_label: Forum option: habitual residence (not public authority)
units.action: bring proceedings against a controller or processor before the courts of the Member State where the data subject has his or her habitual residence
units.scope: judicial proceedings under Article 79
units.exception: unless the controller or processor is a public authority of a Member State acting in the exercise of its public powers
units.proposition: A data subject has the power to bring proceedings under Article 79 before the courts of the Member State of their habitual residence, unless the controller or processor is a public authority of a Member State acting in the exercise of its public powers.

units.ru_label: DS may mandate body to lodge complaint
units.action: mandate a qualified not-for-profit body, organisation or association to lodge the complaint on the data subject's behalf
units.scope: The representative must be not-for-profit, properly constituted under the law of a Member State, have statutory objectives in the public interest, and be active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to mandate a qualified not-for-profit body to lodge the complaint on his or her behalf.

units.ru_label: DS may mandate body to exercise Art77 right
units.action: mandate a qualified not-for-profit body, organisation or association to exercise the right referred to in Article 77 on the data subject's behalf
units.scope: The representative must be not-for-profit, properly constituted under the law of a Member State, have statutory objectives in the public interest, and be active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to mandate a qualified not-for-profit body to exercise the right referred to in Article 77 on his or her behalf.

units.ru_label: DS may mandate body to exercise Art78 right
units.action: mandate a qualified not-for-profit body, organisation or association to exercise the right referred to in Article 78 on the data subject's behalf
units.scope: The representative must be not-for-profit, properly constituted under the law of a Member State, have statutory objectives in the public interest, and be active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to mandate a qualified not-for-profit body to exercise the right referred to in Article 78 on his or her behalf.

units.ru_label: DS may mandate body to exercise Art79 right
units.action: mandate a qualified not-for-profit body, organisation or association to exercise the right referred to in Article 79 on the data subject's behalf
units.scope: The representative must be not-for-profit, properly constituted under the law of a Member State, have statutory objectives in the public interest, and be active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to mandate a qualified not-for-profit body to exercise the right referred to in Article 79 on his or her behalf.

units.ru_label: DS may mandate body to claim Art82 compensation if provided by MS law
units.action: mandate a qualified not-for-profit body, organisation or association to exercise the right to receive compensation referred to in Article 82 on the data subject's behalf
units.scope: The representative must be not-for-profit, properly constituted under the law of a Member State, have statutory objectives in the public interest, and be active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data
units.condition: Where provided for by Member State law
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to mandate a qualified not-for-profit body to exercise on his or her behalf the right to receive compensation referred to in Article 82 where provided for by Member State law.

units.ru_label: MS may allow body to lodge complaint without mandate
units.action: provide that a qualified body, organisation or association has the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority in that Member State independently of a data subject's mandate
units.scope: The body must be one referred to in Article 80(1) (not-for-profit, properly constituted under a Member State's law, with public-interest statutory objectives, and active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data); the supervisory authority must be competent pursuant to Article 77
units.condition: If the body considers that a data subject's rights under the Regulation have been infringed as a result of processing
units.proposition: A Member State may provide that a qualified body has the right, independently of a data subject's mandate, to lodge a complaint in that Member State with the supervisory authority competent under Article 77 if it considers that a data subject's rights have been infringed as a result of processing.

units.ru_label: MS may allow body to exercise Art78 without mandate
units.action: provide that a qualified body, organisation or association has the right to exercise the right referred to in Article 78 independently of a data subject's mandate
units.scope: The body must be one referred to in Article 80(1) (not-for-profit, properly constituted under a Member State's law, with public-interest statutory objectives, and active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data)
units.condition: If the body considers that a data subject's rights under the Regulation have been infringed as a result of processing
units.proposition: A Member State may provide that a qualified body has the right, independently of a data subject's mandate, to exercise the right referred to in Article 78 if it considers that a data subject's rights have been infringed as a result of processing.

units.ru_label: MS may allow body to exercise Art79 without mandate
units.action: provide that a qualified body, organisation or association has the right to exercise the right referred to in Article 79 independently of a data subject's mandate
units.scope: The body must be one referred to in Article 80(1) (not-for-profit, properly constituted under a Member State's law, with public-interest statutory objectives, and active in protecting data subjects' rights and freedoms regarding personal data)
units.condition: If the body considers that a data subject's rights under the Regulation have been infringed as a result of processing
units.proposition: A Member State may provide that a qualified body has the right, independently of a data subject's mandate, to exercise the right referred to in Article 79 if it considers that a data subject's rights have been infringed as a result of processing.

units.addressee: any person who has suffered material or non-material damage
units.action: receive compensation from the controller or processor for the damage suffered
units.scope: damage resulting from an infringement of this Regulation
units.condition: the person has suffered material or non-material damage as a result of an infringement of this Regulation
units.proposition: Any person who has suffered material or non-material damage as a result of an infringement of this Regulation has the right to receive compensation from the controller or processor for the damage suffered.

units.action: be liable for the damage caused by processing that infringes this Regulation
units.scope: damage caused by processing
units.condition: the processing infringes this Regulation
units.proposition: Any controller involved in processing shall be liable for damage caused by processing that infringes this Regulation.

units.action: be liable for the damage caused by processing
units.scope: processor liability for damage caused by processing
units.condition: the processor has not complied with obligations of this Regulation specifically directed to processors or has acted outside or contrary to the controller’s lawful instructions
units.proposition: A processor shall be liable for damage caused by processing only where it has not complied with obligations of this Regulation specifically directed to processors or has acted outside or contrary to the controller’s lawful instructions.

units.action: prove that it is not in any way responsible for the event giving rise to the damage
units.scope: liability under paragraph 2
units.consequence: be exempt from liability under paragraph 2
units.proposition: A controller or processor has the power to obtain exemption from liability under paragraph 2 by proving that it is not in any way responsible for the event giving rise to the damage.

units.addressee: each controller or processor involved in the same processing who is responsible under paragraphs 2 and 3
units.action: be held liable for the entire damage
units.scope: same processing involving more than one controller and/or processor
units.condition: more than one controller or processor, or both a controller and a processor, are involved in the same processing and they are responsible for damage under paragraphs 2 and 3
units.proposition: Where more than one controller or processor, or both a controller and a processor, are involved in the same processing and are responsible under paragraphs 2 and 3, each controller or processor shall be held liable for the entire damage.

units.addressee: controller or processor that has paid full compensation in accordance with paragraph 4
units.action: claim back from the other controllers or processors involved in the same processing the part of the compensation corresponding to their part of responsibility for the damage
units.scope: in accordance with the conditions set out in paragraph 2
units.condition: the controller or processor has paid full compensation for the damage suffered in accordance with paragraph 4
units.proposition: A controller or processor that has paid full compensation in accordance with paragraph 4 has the right to claim back from the other controllers or processors involved in the same processing the part of the compensation corresponding to their part of responsibility for the damage, in accordance with the conditions set out in paragraph 2.

units.addressee: person exercising the right to receive compensation
units.action: bring court proceedings before the courts competent under the law of the Member State referred to in Article 79(2)
units.scope: proceedings to exercise the right to receive compensation
units.proposition: Court proceedings to exercise the right to receive compensation shall be brought before the courts competent under the law of the Member State referred to in Article 79(2).

units.action: lay down rules on other penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation
units.scope: particularly for infringements not subject to administrative fines under Article 83
units.proposition: Member States shall lay down rules on other penalties applicable to infringements of the GDPR, particularly where infringements are not subject to administrative fines under Article 83.

units.action: take all measures necessary to ensure that the penalties laid down under Article 84(1) are implemented
units.proposition: Member States shall take all measures necessary to ensure that the penalties laid down under Article 84(1) are implemented.

units.action: ensure that penalties laid down under Article 84(1) are effective, proportionate and dissuasive
units.proposition: Member States shall ensure that penalties laid down under Article 84(1) are effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

units.action: notify to the Commission the provisions of its law adopted pursuant to Article 84(1)
units.temporal: by 25 May 2018
units.proposition: Each Member State shall notify to the Commission the provisions of its law adopted pursuant to Article 84(1) by 25 May 2018.

units.action: notify to the Commission any subsequent amendment affecting the provisions adopted pursuant to Article 84(1)
units.condition: upon any subsequent amendment affecting the provisions adopted pursuant to Article 84(1)
units.temporal: without delay
units.proposition: Each Member State shall notify to the Commission, without delay, any subsequent amendment affecting the provisions adopted pursuant to Article 84(1).

units.ru_label: Ensure fines are effective, proportionate, dissuasive
units.action: ensure that the imposition of administrative fines is effective, proportionate and dissuasive
units.scope: administrative fines imposed pursuant to Article 83 for infringements referred to in paragraphs 4, 5 and 6
units.condition: in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall ensure that the imposition of administrative fines pursuant to Article 83 for infringements referred to in paragraphs 4, 5 and 6 is, in each individual case, effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

units.ru_label: Power to cumulate or substitute fines with 58(2) measures
units.action: impose an administrative fine in addition to, or instead of, measures under Article 58(2)(a)–(h) and (j)
units.scope: enforcement measures under Article 58(2)
units.condition: depending on the circumstances of each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power, depending on the circumstances of each individual case, to impose an administrative fine in addition to, or instead of, measures under Article 58(2)(a)–(h) and (j).

units.ru_label: Due regard: nature, gravity, duration (and processing context, affected subjects, damage)
units.action: give due regard to the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement
units.scope: including the nature, scope or purpose of the processing concerned, the number of data subjects affected, and the level of damage suffered by them
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, including the nature, scope or purpose of the processing concerned, the number of data subjects affected, and the level of damage suffered by them.

units.ru_label: Due regard: intentional or negligent character
units.action: give due regard to the intentional or negligent character of the infringement
units.scope: administrative fines decisions under Article 83
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to the intentional or negligent character of the infringement.

units.ru_label: Due regard: mitigation actions by controller/processor
units.action: give due regard to any action taken by the controller or processor to mitigate the damage suffered by data subjects
units.scope: administrative fines decisions under Article 83
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to any action taken by the controller or processor to mitigate the damage suffered by data subjects.

units.ru_label: Due regard: degree of responsibility (technical and organisational measures)
units.action: give due regard to the degree of responsibility of the controller or processor
units.scope: taking into account technical and organisational measures implemented by the controller or processor pursuant to Articles 25 and 32
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to the degree of responsibility of the controller or processor, taking into account technical and organisational measures implemented by them pursuant to Articles 25 and 32.

units.action: give due regard to any relevant previous infringements by the controller or processor
units.scope: administrative fines decisions under Article 83
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to any relevant previous infringements by the controller or processor.

units.ru_label: Due regard: degree of cooperation with supervisory authority
units.action: give due regard to the degree of cooperation with the supervisory authority to remedy the infringement and mitigate possible adverse effects
units.scope: administrative fines decisions under Article 83
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall, when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and on the amount in each individual case, give due regard to the degree of cooperation with the supervisory authority to remedy the infringement and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the infringement.

units.ru_label: Due regard: categories of personal data affected
units.action: give due regard to the categories of personal data affected by the infringement
units.scope: administrative fines decisions under Article 83
units.temporal: when deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount in each individual case
